jobs.title: Product Owner Cloud
jobs.description:
Caseware is one of Canada's original Fintech companies, having led the global audit and accounting software industry for over 30 years, with more than 500,000 users across 130 countries and available in 16 different languages. While you might not have heard of us (yet) over 36,000 accounting and audit professionals list Caseware as a skill on their LinkedIn profiles!

As Product Owner for our Cloud solutions, you are responsible for driving the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of our products. You work closely with a full team—both functional and development—so affinity with both is important. You organize and prioritize the team’s work through a well-managed backlog and sprint board, ensuring delivery of maximum value to our customers. 
 
❗This is a Full time permanent position
 
📍 Location:  
This is a hybrid role requiring the successful candidate to work  3 days a week in our Apeldoorn, Netherlands office, located at Fauststraat 3, 7323 BA Apeldoorn, Netherlands

  • Collaborate closely with a full team—both functional and development—so affinity with both is important.
  • Organize and prioritize the team’s work through a well-managed backlog and sprint board.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager – Managed Detection and Incident Response (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
About Eye Security

Eye Security is providing cybersecurity with embedded cyber insurance solutions for organizations in Europe. Headquartered in the Netherlands, we are already over 190 FTEs and continue to grow internationally having secured our Series C funding of €60 Million!

We combine cutting-edge technology with hands-on expertise to detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats in real time. Our team brings together talent from intelligence, military, tech, and consulting backgrounds — all united by a shared mission: to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to every business, not just the big players.

At Eye, you'll work on projects with an international footprint, solving real-world challenges and helping to build a safer digital future for our clients.

About this role

As our client base continues to grow rapidly across Europe, this role will play a key strategic part in scaling our Managed Detection and Response (MDR), Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), and Incident Response (IR) capabilities.

You'll take full ownership of the product strategy and roadmap for this space. Collaborating with our engineers, product designers, security operations, product marketing, and cross-functional leadership, you will ensure that our platform evolves with our customers' needs and delivers maximum impact at scale.

This is a senior individual contributor and thought leadership role designed for someone who thrives on autonomy, discovery, and leading cross-functional product development in a fast-growing environment. You'll be the strategic voice shaping our product direction, mentoring product managers, and influencing broader company strategy.

What you will do

  • Own and communicate the long-term product vision and strategy for MDR, EDR, and IR. Define strategic priorities, influence company OKRs, and drive cross-functional alignment around product direction.

  • Define and own the product roadmap for MDR, EDR, and IR, ensuring alignment with company vision, market opportunity, and customer needs.

  • Drive discovery practices to deeply understand customer needs, problems, and pain points.

  • Lead and mentor product managers and junior team members. Work closely with Engineering, Product Design, Security Operations, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and Sales to deliver successful outcomes and build high-performing teams.

  • Partner with Product Marketing to define comprehensive go-to-market strategies, product launches, and market positioning that drive competitive advantage.

  • Manage external relationships and partnerships, especially with EDR vendors and MDR technology providers, ensuring alignment with our MSP and partner strategy.

  • Stay at the forefront of cybersecurity trends, emerging technologies, and industry best practices.

  • Contribute to the evolution of our internal processes, tooling, and product culture. Champion agile methodologies, data-driven execution, and continuous experimentation.

What you will need

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 4 years in senior or staff-level roles owning end-to-end delivery of software products in B2B SaaS or similar environments.

  • Deep cybersecurity domain expertise.

  • Proven track record of successfully delivering complex software products in fast-paced environments using product discovery, data-driven decision making, and agile methodologies.

  • Strong business acumen: understanding of go-to-market strategy, sales enablement, and how product drives revenue and customer success.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present complex strategies clearly to technical, commercial, and executive audiences.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, with comfort in ambiguity and the ability to make sound decisions with incomplete information.

  • Fluent English

Nice-to-have

  • Startup or scale-up background at a high-growth company.

  • Experience building or scaling product management teams and processes.

  • Exposure to OKR-driven product development and metrics-focused product management.

  • Experience working with MSP or partner-led go-to-market models.

  • Track record of navigating successful product pivots or strategic repositioning.

What we offer

  • A meaningful mission: protect organizations across Europe from real-world cyber threats.

  • Work with top-tier professionals from national CERTs, intelligence agencies, and leading tech backgrounds.

  • Full strategic ownership of a mission-critical product area in a high-growth cybersecurity scale-up.

  • Mentorship and growth: lead and develop the next generation of product managers; grow into broader strategy and leadership roles.

  • Weekly lunches (NL) and Thursday socials to stay connected.

  • A generous time-off policy, including wellbeing and volunteering days.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package, including equity participation.

Are you up for it?

We look forward to receiving your application.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to making our hiring process accessible to everyone. If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply or interview for this role, please inform the TA team.

jobs.title: (Senior) Product Owner – Platform (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Rolle

Vom Kundenportal bis zur Rückgabe: Du prägst die Roadmap unserer Plattform.
Unsere Plattform ist das Herzstück von Everphone. Über sie bestellen Geschäftskunden Smartphones, Tablets und Laptops für ihre Mitarbeitenden, rollen sie aus und geben sie am Ende zurück. Als (Senior) Product Owner (w/m/d) übernimmst du einen Bereich dieser Plattform und gestaltest gemeinsam mit deiner Squad aus Engineers die nächsten Features. Du sprichst mit Kunden sowie mit Operations, Customer Success und Sales. So findest du heraus, wo es wirklich hakt, und machst daraus Lösungen, die im Alltag funktionieren. AI ist dabei dein tägliches Werkzeug: Du analysierst, baust Prototypen und automatisierst damit, und du prägst mit, wie wir als Team mit AI arbeiten. Wenn du gern tief in komplexe Prozesse einsteigst und Dinge vorantreibst, ist diese Rolle für dich gemacht.


Deine Aufgaben

Produktbereich verantworten

  • Strategie und Roadmap: Du entwickelst Strategie und Roadmap deines Produktbereichs und verantwortest das Backlog.
  • Priorisierung: Du arbeitest mit Operations & Logistics, Customer Success und Sales und machst aus ihren konkurrierenden Anforderungen klare Prioritäten.
  • Projekte: Du steuerst mehrere Vorhaben parallel, etwa neue Nutzerrollen mit Freigabeprozessen oder die Anbindung von Partnerportalen.
  • Neue Servicemodelle: Gemeinsam mit Sales und unseren Kunden bewertest du Ideen für neue Servicemodelle, bevor sie in die Umsetzung gehen.

Kunden und Prozesse

  • Gerätelebenszyklus: Du verstehst die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden und ihrer Mitarbeitenden entlang des gesamten Gerätelebenszyklus, von Bestellung und Rollout bis zu Support, Reparatur und Rückgabe. Daraus leitest du klare, gut geschnittene Anforderungen ab.
  • Adoption: Du treibst die Adoption voran und holst regelmäßig Nutzerfeedback ein.
  • Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Du validierst Ideen früh und automatisierst manuelle Schritte in unseren Serviceprozessen.

AI und KPIs

  • AI in der Produktarbeit: Du nutzt AI für die Analyse von Kundenfeedback und Daten und für Produktartefakte.
  • Prototypen: Du baust Prototypen selbst, damit Ideen schneller validiert werden.
  • KPIs: Du definierst und verfolgst Produkt-KPIs und stellst sicher, dass dein Produktbereich messbar zu den Zielen von Everphone beiträgt.


Was Everphone dir bietet

KI ist bei uns Arbeitsalltag

  • KI-Tools ab Tag eins: Moderne KI-Tools stehen allen Rollen zur Verfügung, nicht nur dem Tech-Team
  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Du darfst Prozesse hinterfragen und mit KI neu bauen. Eigene Automatisierungen und Tools sind ausdrücklich erwünscht
  • Voneinander lernen: Kolleg:innen teilen offen, wie sie ihre Arbeit mit KI neu aufgebaut haben, und du lernst direkt aus der Praxis

Zeit & Flexibilität

  • Hybrides Arbeiten & Workation: Eine Mischung aus Office und Homeoffice, dazu bis zu 4 Wochen pro Jahr aus dem EU-Ausland
  • Urlaub: 30 Tage pro Jahr
  • Dein Setup: Laptop und Smartphone deiner Wahl. Wir sind schließlich Device-as-a-Service

Finanzen & Gesundheit

  • Finanzielle Extras: Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, bis zu 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat und 348 € ÖPNV-Zuschuss pro Jahr
  • Essenszuschuss: Wir bezuschussen dein Mittagessen, einfach Beleg per App hochladen
  • Gesundheit: Bezuschusste Urban-Sports-Club-Mitgliedschaft und kostenfreie, vertrauliche mentale Unterstützung über Voiio

Gemeinschaft

  • Im Office: Wöchentliche bezahlte Company Lunches und Frühstücks-Events, frisches Obst, Snacks und Kaffeespezialitäten. Und dein Hund ist auch willkommen
  • Sprachen: Vollständig finanzierte Deutsch- und Englischkurse, damit sich im internationalen Team alle gut verstehen
  • Community: Sommer- und Winterfest sowie Employee Resource Groups, in denen du dich vernetzen und einbringen kannst


Das bringst du mit

Must-haves

  • Produkterfahrung: Du hast 3 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung als Product Owner oder Product Manager für digitale Produkte, idealerweise für eine B2B-Plattform oder ein SaaS-Produkt. Du hast einen Produktbereich end-to-end verantwortet und kannst deine Erfolge mit Zahlen belegen.
  • AI-first: AI gehört fest zu deinem Arbeitsalltag. Du hast damit selbst Dinge gebaut, zum Beispiel per Vibe Coding entwickelte Tools, Prototypen, Analysen oder Skripte. Du weißt, wo AI hilft und wo nicht, und bringst dein Team damit weiter.
  • Agile Produktentwicklung: Du hast Erfahrung in agiler Produktentwicklung und übersetzt komplexe, wenig standardisierte Prozesse in einfache, nutzerfreundliche Lösungen.
  • Stakeholder und Change: Du überzeugst Führungskräfte, Kund:innen und Fachbereiche, verhandelst Trade-offs und setzt Veränderungen bereichsübergreifend durch.
  • Technisches Verständnis: Du musst nicht selbst programmieren, verstehst aber den Softwareentwicklungsprozess. Du ordnest Aussagen von Entwickler:innen zu Deployments oder Problemen ein und mergst bei Bedarf selbst Code in GitHub.
  • Problemlösung: Du durchdringst komplexe Sachverhalte schnell, deckst mit kritischen Fragen die eigentlichen Probleme auf und findest kreative Lösungen.
  • Umsetzungsstärke: Du packst selbst an und bringst Engineers und Stakeholder unaufgeregt, aber direkt nach vorn.
  • Sprachen: Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch mindestens auf C1-Niveau 
Nice-to-haves
  • Branchenerfahrung: Du kennst Online-Bestellprozesse in Verbindung mit physischer Logistik, zum Beispiel aus E-Commerce.


Not a perfect match? Apply anyway! Wenn dich die Rolle begeistert, freuen wir uns sehr auf deine Bewerbung – auch wenn du nicht alles erfüllst. Schau nur, ob die wichtigsten Punkte wie Sprachkenntnisse passen.

jobs.title: Product Manager On-Ramp & Swap (100% remote)
jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Tether Wallet is our self-custodial wallet, built to bring USDT and XAUT directly to the people who rely on Tether every day, especially in markets where access to stable money and savings is hardest. For that to work, getting into these assets has to be simple, fast and affordable. Our goal is to give every Tether Wallet user the best option to exchange any local currency or token into USDT and XAUT, wherever they are.

In this role, you will define and own the strategy for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT across our target markets. You will work hand in hand with our expansion teams to map the payment landscape in each market: which payment methods people actually use, which card schemes and bank rails dominate, and which on-ramp and swap providers can serve them. Based on that, you will identify the best partner for each market and bring them on board as a service partner of Tether Wallet.

This role sits at the intersection of product, payments and partnerships. You will own the outcome end to end, from the first partner evaluation through integration and the in-app experience to the conversion numbers after launch. If you enjoy turning a fragmented global payments landscape into a buy button that just works, we want to hear from you.

Key responsibilities:

  • Buy & Swap Strategy: Define and own the strategy and roadmap for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT in Tether Wallet, covering fiat on-ramps, card payments, local payment methods and token-to-token swaps.

  • Market & Payment Landscape: Work with our expansion teams to build a deep understanding of each target market, including dominant payment methods, card schemes, bank transfer and instant payment rails, mobile money, local regulation, and the on-ramp and swap providers active there.

  • Partner Evaluation & Selection: Define clear evaluation criteria such as market and payment method coverage, fees and FX spreads, approval and conversion rates, KYC experience, settlement speed, reliability and compliance standing, and use them to select the best on-ramp or swap partner for each market.

  • Partner Onboarding: Lead selected partners from evaluation to go-live as service partners of Tether Wallet, coordinating with Legal, Compliance and Business Development on due diligence, commercial terms and contracts.

  • Integration & Delivery: Translate partner capabilities and APIs into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, and work with engineering and design to deliver a seamless in-app buy and swap experience.

  • Routing & Optimization: Define the logic that decides which partner and payment method a user is offered based on country, currency, amount, price and availability, so every user gets the best available option.

  • Performance & Partner Management: Define and track KPIs across the buy and swap funnel, such as conversion, payment approval rates, KYC drop-off, total cost to the user and volume by market and partner. Use the data to improve the experience, manage partner performance and incidents, and regularly review whether each market still has the right partner.


Mandatory:

  • 5+ years of product management experience in the financial industry (banking, payment service provider, FinTech)

  • 3+ years of product management experience in DeFi or crypto industry

  • Good understanding of crypto wallets and DeFi features, including token swaps, DEX aggregators and on-chain transaction flows.

  • Good understanding of global payment systems and credit card schemes (e.g. Visa, Mastercard), including authorization, 3-D Secure and chargebacks, as well as local payment methods such as bank transfers, instant payment rails and mobile money.

  • Hands-on experience with fiat on-ramp, off-ramp or swap providers, or with integrating third-party payment providers and gateways into a consumer product.

  • Proven experience evaluating, selecting and onboarding external partners, and managing their performance after launch.

  • Working knowledge of KYC/AML requirements and how they affect user onboarding and conversion.

  • Technical enough to read partner API documentation, assess integration options and work closely with engineering teams.

  • Data-driven: experience defining funnel KPIs and using data to improve conversion and make partner decisions.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with partners, expansion teams and engineers across time zones in a remote environment.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

jobs.title: Senior/Principal Product Manager - Operations
jobs.description:
About our team:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we are looking to expand our product team with leaders who can combine technical strength with execution excellence and are driven to build.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

Job Summary:

As a Senior Product Manager - Operations, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of Radiant’s internal tooling and integrations, helping teams operate and scale the cloud platform efficiently.

You’ll work across CMDB, asset and service inventory, internal APIs, workflow automation, third-party integrations, and platform administration, partnering closely with engineering, SRE, infrastructure, networking, security, and operations.

This is a highly technical product role focused on reducing operational friction, improving self-service, and creating reliable, scalable internal systems.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of internal tooling, CMDB, service catalogues, operational workflows, and integrations.

  • Translate business and operational needs into clear product requirements, specs, user stories, data models, and priorities.

  • Partner with engineering to define solutions across APIs, integrations, automation, and platform tooling.

  • Work with SRE, infrastructure, security, support, and other internal users to identify pain points and improve automation and self-service.

  • Establish reliable sources of truth for infrastructure, services, customers, environments, ownership, and configuration.

  • Drive prioritisation, backlog management, technical design discussions, delivery, and adoption.

  • Define success metrics and ensure tooling is secure, observable, auditable, reliable, and well documented.

  • Evaluate build vs. buy decisions and third-party tooling where appropriate.

Qualifications:

  • Experience owning technical products, internal platforms, developer tooling, or infrastructure products end-to-end.

  • Experience working across data centre operations, hardware lifecycle and inventory, infrastructure support, field operations, or adjacent operational environments.

  • Strong technical fluency across:

    • APIs & integrations: REST, gRPC, webhooks, third-party APIs

    • Infrastructure: Kubernetes, cloud platforms, containers, infrastructure-as-code

    • Data & CMDB: relational modelling, inventory, ownership, dependency mapping

    • Automation: queues, schedulers, workflow engines, event-driven systems

    • Observability & security: logging, metrics, tracing, IAM, RBAC, audit logging

  • Familiarity with tools such as NetBox, ServiceNow, Terraform, Grafana, Jira, or similar.

  • Strong understanding of distributed systems concepts including retries, idempotency, eventual consistency, and failure handling.

  • Strong prioritisation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Comfortable working closely with engineers and making informed technical trade-offs without needing to be the primary implementer.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment and taking ambiguous problems from discovery through to delivery.

What you bring:

  • Systems thinking: Understand how infrastructure, services, data, and operational workflows fit together.

  • Product thinking: Treat internal teams as customers and focus on measurable outcomes.

  • Technical fluency: Able to work credibly across APIs, integrations, infrastructure, data, and architecture.

  • Prioritisation: Balance operational pain, strategic value, technical complexity, and business impact.

  • Ownership: Drive ambiguous problems from discovery and definition through to adoption and iteration.

Our values:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There’s no blueprint for the future. You’ll embrace challenges and change

  • You’re real and you’re true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you’ll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you’re talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.

  • Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction.

Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage.

Technical Product Leadership

  • Develop a deep working understanding of the Holepunch P2P stack (Pear runtime, Bare, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, HyperDHT, Autobase, Hyperbee) and translate its capabilities and constraints into product decisions.

  • Partner with core engineering on hard P2P problems at scale, including NAT traversal, offline sync, multi-device support, large groups, push notifications, and battery and data efficiency on mobile.

  • Own the real-time calling experience (1:1 and group voice and video, plus screen sharing) to a quality bar that matches or beats Google Meet and Zoom.

  • Define clear feature tiers with explicit labels for stable versus experimental functionality.

Rapid Prototyping with AI

  • Use AI coding and design tools to build working prototypes and demos that prove concepts before committing engineering resources.

  • Turn ideas into something the team, users and the board can see and touch within days.

Execution & Team Leadership

  • Lead the product team and run the sprint cadence end to end, covering planning, prioritization, standups, reviews and retrospectives.

  • Own deliverables from conception through release, testing and post-launch iteration, ensuring core functionality works reliably every time.

  • Maintain issue trackers and roadmaps that accurately reflect priorities and sprint commitments.

  • Coordinate across engineering, QA, design, marketing and business stakeholders, and manage cross-team dependencies across the Holepunch and Tether ecosystem.

  • Provide transparent updates on status, risks and timeline changes, and hold direct conversations about accountability when needed.

Mobile & Distribution

  • Own the mobile release process across iOS and Android. This includes App Store and Google Play submissions, review guidelines, compliance, store listings, ratings and release management.

  • Oversee desktop distribution and installers across macOS, Windows and Linux.

  • Build crash reporting, debugging and analytics systems, privacy-preserving by design, that turn user reports into actionable engineering data.

  • Strong product sense, with a proven track record of setting product vision and driving it to measurable outcomes at scale (tens of millions of users or more).

  • Deep JavaScript and React skills. You can read and write production code, review pull requests, and build working prototypes yourself.

  • Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. You don't need P2P expertise, because our core abstracts it away, but you should be able to reason about sync, offline behavior and consistency trade-offs.

  • Hands-on experience shipping and scaling mobile apps on iOS and Android, with deep familiarity with App Store and Google Play logistics, review processes and release management.

  • Experience with real-time voice and video calling products (such as Google Meet, Zoom, FaceTime or WhatsApp calls) and the quality, latency and reliability trade-offs involved.

  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to rapidly prototype and demonstrate product concepts.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with experience presenting vision and strategy to boards, executives and investors.

  • A strong understanding of urgency versus importance, and the judgment to make fast, high-quality decisions with incomplete information.

  • You thrive in a high-intensity, fast-moving environment, set an exceptionally high bar, and are willing to go above and beyond, including extended hours, when the mission demands it.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have:

  • Product leadership experience at a major messaging app such as WhatsApp, Telegram, LINE, WeChat, Signal, Viber or KakaoTalk.

  • Experience with peer-to-peer technologies, distributed systems or decentralized protocols. Prior exposure to Holepunch, Pear or Hypercore is a strong plus.

  • Experience growing a product in emerging markets or across multiple regions and languages.

  • A background in privacy, encryption or security-focused products.

  • Familiarity with Electron, React Native or similar cross-platform frameworks, as well as installer systems, boot performance and Linux packaging (Snap, AppImage, Flatpak).

  • A solid understanding of testing approaches (unit, integration, end-to-end), test automation and performance testing.

  • An engineering background or computer science degree.

  • Experience with Git, issue trackers and modern collaboration tools.

Why this role:

The next billion-user communication app will not run on someone else's servers. If you want to be the person who defines it, presents it to the board, prototypes it yourself, and then leads the team that ships it, we want to hear from you.

In your application, include a link to a product you have shipped or a prototype you have built, along with a few sentences on how you would take Keet to 1 billion users.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Wanna join the adventure?

At Loft, we are convinced that space programs should not have to be rebuilt from scratch every time. Our philosophy has been to productize them: we develop our own proprietary technology blocks, hardware and software, so that a customer payload can be integrated faster and more reliably than any bespoke program allows. That approach has delivered — it is why our customers reach orbit in months rather than years, and it is what makes working here different from working in the rest of the industry.

We are now taking the next step: launching and operating our own constellations, and building a new set of services on top of them. That includes a full product suite enabling third-party AI applications to run directly onboard our satellites, and a growing ecosystem of partners whose needs we have to understand and design for. Loft is expanding at a very high pace, and the range of what we build is expanding just as fast.

This is why Product Management matters so much here. Someone has to hold the whole picture — what is technically possible, what customers actually need, what we should build first — and turn it into something engineering and leadership can act on. As a Product Manager, you will own a significant perimeter and the autonomy that goes with it. We are growing the team precisely so that each of us can go deeper on our topics, anticipate rather than react, and have more impact across the company.

You will need to be comfortable talking to anyone here. In the same week you might sit with a system engineer to understand a design constraint, join a BD call with an institutional customer, and present a recommendation to the executive team. Ideas at Loft get discussed openly and on their merits, wherever they come from, so being able to ask a naive question without ego — and to disagree with someone senior without making it personal — matters more than seniority.


About this role:
Understand what is possible, and turn it into requirements
  • Spend the bulk of your time with engineering: understanding architectures, constraints, and dependencies well enough to judge what is realistically doable in a given timeframe.
  • Translate strategic direction into clear requirements and use cases that engineering can act on directly, and follow them down to the Jira tickets.
  • Surface and shape the good ideas that come from engineering — many of the best ones do — and connect them to a product rationale.
  • Define success criteria for each capability, and verify they are actually met through implementation and delivery.
  • Maintain an accurate, shared view of Loft's product capabilities, what is in development, and where the gaps are.

    • Bring the outside in

    • Run customer discovery interviews alongside business development, and debrief missions to see how Loft's capabilities are actually used in operations.
    • Engage directly with the partners building on our platform, including the onboard AI application ecosystem, to understand their needs and constraints.
    • Track market trends and competitive moves closely enough to know where our offering stands.

      • Decide and prioritize

      • Own the roadmap for your perimeter, reconciling customer needs, engineering reality, and Loft's strategy into a single coherent plan.
      • Build the analysis behind every recommendation — sizing, segmentation, business cases, operational data — so decisions are grounded in evidence rather than intuition alone.
      • Negotiate scope and delivery commitments with engineering leadership, and re-plan when capacity or mission timelines shift.
      • Challenge, constructively and with data, business development, engineering leadership, and your own assumptions.

        • Communicate

        • Own internal communication on your perimeter: keep engineering, program leadership, and executives working from the same technical reality.
        • Develop the technical narratives and proof points that marketing and BD then turn into their own customer-facing material.
        • Prepare recommendations and presentations for top-executive-level audiences.

Must Haves:
  • 7+ years of professional experience, including hands-on product management.
  • Domain experience in at least one of: earth observation, embedded systems, aerospace systems, security & defense.
  • Comfort at both ends of the spectrum — understand the market, and the technology
  • Structured and data-driven: you bring your experience and your intuitions, but when you put a recommendation on the table you can show the analysis it stands on.
  • Real product obsession: you think about the bigger picture and product-market fit before you think about features.
  • Relentless curiosity. In a single month you might move from a satellite bus constraint, to onboard AI inference, to a defense accreditation requirement — and you need to find that stimulating rather than exhausting.
  • High autonomy and a bias for action: handed a broad perimeter, you organize it yourself and come back with a plan.
  • At ease being challenged, and challenging others, in a fast-moving and demanding environment.
  • Working knowledge of both hardware and software development lifecycles.
  • Proficient using and configuring Atlassian tools (Jira and Confluence).
  • Fluency in English, written and spoken.
  • Willingness to travel to other Loft offices and to customers.

Nice to Haves:
  • Fluency in French.
  • Experience with AI/ML products, edge computing, or developer and partner platforms and ecosystems.
  • Experience with satellite operations, constellation services, or ground segment products.
  • Exposure to institutional and defense customers and their procurement cycles.
  • Experience in a fast-growing, entrepreneurial NewSpace company or venture-backed deep-tech startup.
  • Professional experience working with international teams across time zones.

Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
  • Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together
  • Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable
    •  *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions.  We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.

    Who We Are

    Loft: Space Made Simple. 

    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.

    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

    With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.

    As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

Changing your car should feel like one seamless journey, not a series of disconnected tasks. Right now it's the opposite: people value their car in one place, search for the next one in another, and manage the handover somewhere else, much of it on the web and most of it forgotten between car changes. The Carwow app is our most direct relationship with those customers, and today it is nowhere near what it could be.

We are reimagining it. If we can give people a reason to open Carwow between car changes, understand what they drive and what they want next, and make the moment of changing effortless, the app becomes the place UK drivers start. This role is the product voice at the table for that: setting the direction for what we build and working day to day with design and engineering to build it.

This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. The best consumer apps of the next few years won't be lists with filters; they will understand you and act on your behalf. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, the fluency to prototype it quickly with the latest tools, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise.

If you want to shape a new consumer product from the ground up, work at the cutting edge of applied AI, and build things that millions of UK drivers could use, this is it.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Product Strategy & Execution:

    • Set the product direction for the Carwow consumer app, defining what we build, in what order, and why

    • Lead discovery work with consumers: interviews, usage data, behavioural analysis, to build a precise understanding of where the app can add the most value

    • Identify, prototype and ship opportunities to bring AI into the app: smarter discovery, personalisation and recommendations that actually change behaviour

    • Collaborate with the Engineering Manager, Designer and Engineers as a product trio to ship well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics

    • Manage the backlog with commercial awareness, prioritising work that drives engagement, retention and revenue, not just activity

  • Design & Engineering Partnership:

    • Work shoulder to shoulder with design to shape journeys and screens from the ground up, and test them with users before engineering starts

    • Work with engineers on the right trade-offs for a native app: release cadence, quality and what to build versus reuse

    • Use AI tools every day in your own work, prototyping, synthesising research and analysing data, so the squad learns faster and ships more

  • Cross-functional Leadership:

    • Work across product, engineering, data, CRM and marketing to align on priorities and ship coherently

    • Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders, written as well as verbal

    • Own the app's success measures and bring clean evidence, including holdouts and controlled tests, to decisions on what to scale, change or stop

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including time owning a consumer mobile app, with evidence of improving engagement or retention metrics

  • Hands-on experience with product discovery: you run your own interviews, interrogate your own data, and form your own hypotheses rather than waiting for research to land in your inbox

  • AI-native: you use AI tools daily, you have shipped or prototyped AI-powered features, and you have a clear point of view on where it adds real value for consumers

  • Comfort with ambiguity: this role involves defining the problem as much as solving it, and the scope will evolve as evidence comes in

  • A proven partnership with design and engineering: you have worked as a product trio and can hold a credible conversation about journeys, architecture and app quality

  • Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a complex trade-off simply and bring people with you

NICE TO HAVE

As we continue to develop the Nyx vehicle and prepare its future missions, strong program coordination is essential. We are looking for a motivated and structured Nyx PMO to support the Chief Program Manager and the Project Management teams in preparing, integrating and tracking schedules across our international organisation.

Your Mission

As a member of the Nyx Program Management Office, you will support the preparation and integration of project schedules and help maintain reliable, up-to-date program data. You will work closely with Project Managers and teams across Munich, Bordeaux and Turin to ensure that planning information is collected, structured and available for effective programme decision-making.

This is a junior position offering broad exposure to program management, project planning and the development of a complex space vehicle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the preparation and integration of Nyx project and program schedules.

  • Collect schedule inputs from project managers and consolidate them into coherent planning views.

  • Maintain schedule data, activity progress, milestones, dependencies and tracking information up to date.

  • Follow up with stakeholders to obtain status updates and clarify missing or inconsistent information.

What You Bring

jobs.title: Account Executive (Spanish and Italian speaker)
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


Position:

Sonar is looking for an Inside Sales Executive to join a Major Accounts pod and support two Major Account Managers in covering a portfolio of key accounts end to end. You will help the pod reach complete coverage of each account by prospecting into entities that are not yet customers and supporting entities that already run Sonar instances. You will own the full sales cycle on the opportunities you source: qualification, proof of concept, business case, negotiation with procurement and close.


On a daily basis, you will

  • Partner with two Major Account Managers in a pod model to build and execute account plans that give full coverage of key accounts and their business units

  • Generate new leads and opportunities in entities of key accounts that are not yet Sonar customers, using a multi-channel approach (LinkedIn, email, video, cold calls and meetings) to convert identified prospects into new logos

  • Work with channel partners to generate and grow pipeline within the accounts you cover

  • Engage and grow entities that already run Sonar instances, identifying new teams, use cases, products and editions

  • Qualify opportunities with BANT and MEDDPICC to understand the customer's needs, pains, decision process, economic buyer and champion

  • Run discovery calls and demos, and guide prospects through proofs of concept and trials with Solutions Engineers, validating Sonar's value against agreed success criteria

  • Size and quote customer software license needs

  • Build the business case and mutual action plan with the customer, then drive the deal through stakeholder alignment, security and legal review, negotiation with procurement, and signature

  • Capture all account and opportunity information accurately in Salesforce (stage, next steps, forecast category, MEDDPICC fields), and use it to set daily activity and forecast the pipeline

  • Support Marketing with account-based, customer-focused campaigns, and work with SDRs, Customer Success and Sales Operations to hand over smoothly after the sale

  • Meet or exceed quarterly and yearly targets for pipeline creation and bookings

  • Share customer and competitive insights, and proactively build, grow and share sales team best practices


    • The skills you will demonstrate

  • Have 2 to 5 years of experience in a B2B sales role (Inside Sales, SDR/BDR moving into an AE role, Account Executive or Account Manager), ideally in a SaaS or subscription model

  • Have a proven track record of creating pipeline and closing deals, with exposure to the full sales cycle from prospecting to negotiation

  • Know a structured qualification methodology such as BANT and MEDDPICC, and apply it consistently to understand customer needs, pains and decision processes

  • Have experience selling a technical product to a technical buyer, as well as to business stakeholders such as security teams and procurement

  • Have proven prospecting skills across channels and tools such as Outreach, ZoomInfo, SalesLoft, LinkedIn, calling and networking

  • Be familiar with selling to and negotiating with mid-market and enterprise customers, including deals above 20k USD

  • Communicate confidently with executive-level contacts and tailor value messages to the persona, with both bottom-up and top-down approaches

  • Be comfortable running discovery calls, demos and technical evaluations or POCs alongside a Solutions Engineer

  • Be able to negotiate commercial terms and navigate procurement, legal and security reviews through to signature

  • Have Salesforce expertise and be highly organized: manage many accounts and opportunities in parallel, with accurate CRM hygiene and forecasting

  • Be customer-centric: we want happy customers

  • Show strong communication and listening skills, handle objections well, and welcome feedback and coaching

  • Be a self-driven, proactive and hungry team player who works well in a pod structure with senior Account Managers and cares about team and company goals

  • Have experience selling software development tooling or selling into the development side of IT, and closing deals internationally (a plus)

  • Be curious about how AI-assisted development changes code quality and security

    • In-office culture

    We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 

    Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted  — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

     

    We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

    At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

    If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. 

    Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

About us

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

As an interim Senior QA Specialist at Rentman, you make sure every release reaches customers without regressions. You own the test strategy across our 3 product teams and finish moving regression testing from a manual release-day cycle to an automated, shift-left E2E suite. Without this role, quality depends on manual testing on release day, bugs show up in staging or production, and the move to automated testing stalls. This is an interim position: the duration is still to be confirmed, and the role ends once the assignment is complete.

What you'll do

  • Join refinement with the product teams and write Gherkin (Given/When/Then) acceptance specs that developers turn into tests

  • Test new features on staging, going beyond the acceptance criteria to find edge cases, and file clear, reproducible bug reports in Jira

  • Write and review Playwright tests (TypeScript) in the frontend repo, and review developer-written tests in pull requests

  • Monitor the daily automated regression run in GitHub Actions, triage failures the same day, and fix flaky tests at the root cause

  • Run release-day regression and the OWASP ZAP security scan for each release, and give a clear go / no-go call

  • Migrate the remaining legacy tests and decide what is worth automating and what stays manual

  • Organise cross-team QA days and coach developers so they own their tests

     

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years in QA on web applications

  • At least 2 years writing and maintaining UI test automation in code (Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, ideally TypeScript/JavaScript), not only record-and-play tools

  • Strong manual and exploratory testing, with bug reports developers can act on without follow-up questions

  • You have defined a test strategy (what to automate, what to test manually, coverage), not only executed test cases

  • Experience running automated tests in CI (GitHub Actions or similar)

  • You get developers to adopt new habits through pairing, good examples and clear specs, not by policing

     

Nice to haves

  • Experience with complex B2B SaaS

  • Playwright specifically, and Gherkin / BDD

jobs.description:
About P1 Security

Founded in 2011 by serial entrepreneur and security expert Philippe Langlois, P1 Security is on a mission to secure critical and sovereign mobile networks by providing services and technologies to identify, detect and recover from critical threats and vulnerabilities.

P1 Security is one of the very few companies in the world tackling telecom security through pure Mobile and Telecom Security attacks and security from 5G and Cloud-based infrastructure Security, OpenRAN, Network Slicing and RAN Sharing, Edge Computing (MEC), down to legacy 2/3/4G Diameter, SS7 SIGTRAN attacks, GTP manipulation and fuzzing.

Our offering and expertise range from Network and Telecom Core Network Security, Intrusion Detection and Vulnerability Assessment solutions, with technology backed by more than a decade of engineering research. We are a lean scale-up, engaged in emerging markets (Eastern Europe, Middle East, Asia), Europe and North America.

The P1 Security team includes experts from telecom operators and security companies as well as renowned security researchers who regularly present unique P1 Security research at leading international security conferences & GSMA working groups. P1 Labs, the R&D branch of P1 Security, shares Open Source initiatives with the telecom security community (www.github.com/P1sec/).

We are growing the team with people who want to help write it. We are looking for experienced profiles with grounded, hands-on knowledge of telecom networks — and a real appetite for FTTx technologies in particular. Curious, creative and open-minded people who want to dig deep into a genuinely sovereign topic: the security of the mobile networks our connectivity runs on.

Job Description

If your years have been spent in FTTx — access networks, PON, CPE, provisioning, field operations — and security has always been the question you kept coming back to, talk to us. The role described below does not really exist as a box to tick yet: we care far more about the person than about an exact match with a job title. Bring the part of the picture you know best, and we will build the rest together.

What you will do

  • Audits — you will plan and run scoped, authorized penetration tests of FTTH/PON infrastructure: OLTs, ONTs/ONUs, the management systems around the ODN, and customer premises equipment.

  • PON internals — you will dig into GPON, XG-PON, XGS-PON and NG-PON2: OMCI, PLOAM, and how ONTs are authenticated and provisioned.

  • CPE and gateways — you will take them apart: firmware extraction and reverse engineering, exposed debug interfaces (UART/JTAG), hardcoded credentials, update mechanisms and web/CLI management flaws.

  • Subscribers at scale — you will look at what provisions and manages them (TR-069/CWMP, TR-369/USP, ACS/OSS/BSS integrations, zero-touch provisioning) and at the subscriber-facing edge: BNG/BRAS, PPPoE/IPoE, DHCP, RADIUS/AAA, VLAN segmentation, QoS and isolation between subscribers.

  • Convergence and infrastructure — you will follow fixed–mobile convergence (5G FWA, shared core, shared OSS/BSS, unified identity and billing) and review devices and management planes (routers, switches, aggregation equipment, NMS/EMS, SNMP, NETCONF/YANG, SSH/Telnet, APIs, privileged access) against vendor and industry hardening baselines.

  • Threat modeling — you will map attack paths for real operator environments using frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, the GSMA FASG/FS.xx guidance and the MITRE FiGHT knowledge base.

  • Findings and clients — you will turn all of this into clear, prioritized reports with proof-of-concept evidence, risk ratings and actionable remediation, present them to stakeholders, and support remediation verification and retesting.

  • The team — you will contribute to our internal tooling, test methodologies, lab environments and reusable attack playbooks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep knowledge on Fixed-line network architecture (FTTx, DSL, Coaxial)

  • MANDATORY: Experience in security audit pentests on OT and IT infrastructure

  • Experience with vendor ecosystems such as Huawei, ZTE, Nokia, Ericsson, Calix, or Adtran FTTH equipment.

  • Familiarity with telecom security standards and frameworks: 3GPP SCAS, GSMA NESAS, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, and ITU-T/BBF specifications.

  • Experience in red teaming or adversary emulation against critical infrastructure.

  • Relevant certifications, such as:

  • OSCP / OSEP / OSWE / OSED

  • GPEN / GXPN / GRID

  • CEH (Practical), eJPT/eCPPT, or CRTO

  • Telecom-specific training (GSMA, Black Hat/DEF CON telecom or hardware trainings)

  • Published research, CVEs, conference talks, or bug bounty history in telecom or embedded devices.

If you have a passion for telecom security and want to be part of a dynamic and innovative team, we encourage you to apply and join us in shaping the future of Telecom Security!

Language requirements

  • English - fluent speaker

  • French - optional

Further details

  • 🏢 Headquarters: Fully remote company, with headquarters in Paris - FRANCE

  • 🏠 Remote policy:

  • At P1 Security, we recognize the importance of work-life balance, and that's why our remote policy is a key part of our company culture. We understand that flexibility is crucial, allowing our team members to work remotely while achieving their personal and professional goals. To keep our team connected, we schedule monthly meetups with department members and gather the entire team on-site every two months. These regular touch points ensure effective communication, collaboration, and a dynamic team spirit, reflecting the dynamic and adaptable spirit of P1 Security. We believe in the power of flexible work arrangements to bring out the best in our team, driving success in a way that suits everyone's unique lifestyle

And because the Attendi App is being certified as a medical device (MDR), we don’t just design what feels intuitive, we prove that users understand and use it as intended.

This isn’t about making it as easy as possible to order a pizza. It’s about how a care professional can receive AI-generated advice safely, and make sure they check what matters before they rely on it.

Your Role
As a UX Designer at Attendi, you will:

  • Translate user research into user flows, wireframes and high-fidelity designs for the Attendi App.

  • Visit care organisations to test your designs with healthcare professionals: does this solution fit the problem we observed?

  • Design for safety in an AI product: identify where users could misuse or over-trust AI output, and design features that mitigate that risk.

  • Run usability studies as part of our MDR certification, through simulations, observation or A/B tests, and document what you tested and learned.

  • Work in two lanes: fast shipping of new features, and careful, well-documented work on our medical device track.

  • Work closely with the product owner, developers and our compliance team to get designs into production.

You might be a good fit if you hit most or all of the following:

  • 2-4 years of experience as a UX or product designer in a product team, working in sprints.

  • You start with questions, not solutions: who is the user, what is their context, what problem are we really solving?

  • You balance a startup pace with taking a step back to research and test before going to production.

  • Strong Figma skills.

  • Native Dutch speaker. You’ll talk with healthcare professionals a lot, in their own language.

  • A portfolio that shows your thinking: the user, the problem, how you approached it and how you measured whether it worked.

Strong candidates may also

Market Understanding and Opportunity Identification

Business Cases and Strategy

Ce stage a pour but de penser, concevoir et produire une version améliorée permettant d'automatiser les interactions physiques — prendre une mesure, monter sur une balance, porter une montre, appuyer sur un bouton, vérifier ce que l'écran du dispositif affiche — afin de convertir en tests automatiques (python) les cas de tests exécutés à la main.

En forte interaction avec la QA Firmware, vos principales responsabilités incluront :

jobs.title: Ingénieur PS Zero Trust / SASE (Cloudflare One)
jobs.description:
À propos de Brixio

Brixio est un partenaire spécialiste de Cloudflare : intégration, services professionnels et services managés sur l'ensemble de la plateforme, de la sécurité applicative au SASE. Brixio est partenaire Cloudflare certifié ASDP et fait partie depuis juillet 2026 du groupe Equans (groupe Bouygues), 18,7 Md€ de chiffre d'affaires et environ 85 000 personnes.

L'équipe compte une trentaine d'ingénieurs répartis entre Paris, Dubaï et un centre de production à Casablanca. Les clients sont des grands comptes et des ETI en France, en Europe et au Moyen-Orient, ainsi que les entités du groupe Equans.

La mission

L'ingénieur PS Zero Trust / SASE déploie Cloudflare One chez les clients français de Brixio, du cadrage technique à la mise en production. Il devient la référence opérationnelle Zero Trust de l'équipe France et prend en charge les projets SASE dès son arrivée, notamment le déploiement interne de Cloudflare One chez Brixio et l'accès distant sécurisé aux sites industriels du groupe Equans.

Il travaille avec le Delivery Manager France, qui pilote le planning, le budget et la relation projet, et avec l'architecte principal, référent technique de l'équipe.

Responsabilités

  • Cadrage : animer les ateliers techniques avec les équipes réseau, sécurité et poste de travail du client, puis rédiger le design détaillé (architecture d'accès, politiques, plan de migration).
  • Déploiement Cloudflare One : Access (ZTNA), Gateway (SWG et filtrage DNS), client WARP, Tunnel, CASB, DLP, isolation de navigation (RBI), et selon les projets Magic WAN, Magic Firewall et Email Security.
  • Migrations : remplacer les VPN par du ZTNA et les proxies existants par Gateway, sans rupture de service pour les utilisateurs.
  • Intégrations : fournisseurs d'identité (Entra ID, Okta) en SAML, OIDC et SCIM, contrôles de posture (Intune, EDR), remontée des logs vers le SIEM du client.
  • OT et industrie : sécuriser l'accès distant des prestataires et techniciens aux équipements industriels et techniques.
  • Sécurité des usages IA : appliquer les contrôles Cloudflare One aux usages de l'IA (détection du shadow AI, DLP sur les prompts, gouvernance des applications IA).
  • Livraison et passation : documentation (HLD, LLD, runbooks), recette avec le client, passation au support et au MSP de Casablanca.
  • Rigueur projet : travailler dans le périmètre signé, signaler au Delivery Manager toute demande hors périmètre avant de la traiter, et saisir son temps chaque semaine dans Brixio One.
  • Industrialisation : contribuer aux modèles de déploiement réutilisables (configurations types, Terraform, playbooks) pour accélérer les projets suivants.

Requirements

Profil indispensable

Le poste demande d'être opérationnel sur le SASE dès les premières semaines. Sans expérience SASE en production, la candidature ne sera pas retenue.

  • SASE en production : au moins 2 ans de déploiements Zero Trust / SASE chez des clients, sur Cloudflare One, Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA), Netskope, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Cato Networks ou Fortinet SASE.
  • Expérience : 3 à 6 ans en sécurité réseau, intégration ou services professionnels.
  • Fondamentaux réseau : TCP/IP, DNS, TLS et PKI, routage, VPN IPsec, proxies, pare-feu.
  • Identité : SSO en SAML et OIDC, provisioning SCIM, Entra ID ou Okta.
  • Poste de travail : déploiement d'agents à grande échelle, MDM et contrôles de posture.
  • Relation client : capacité à animer seul un atelier technique et à rédiger une documentation claire.
  • Langues : français courant, anglais professionnel (équipe internationale).
  • Mobilité : déplacements réguliers chez les clients en France, ponctuellement en Europe.

Atouts

  • Expérience directe de Cloudflare One, ou certification Cloudflare (sinon, à obtenir dans les 90 jours suivant l'arrivée).
  • Automatisation : Terraform, API, scripts Python.
  • Connaissance des environnements OT et industriels.
  • Connaissance des exigences NIS2 et DORA.
  • Intérêt pour l'IA et pour la plateforme développeurs de Cloudflare (AI Gateway, Workers).

Évolution et ce que Brixio offre

Le poste démarre sur le SASE mais ne s'y limite pas. Il s'ouvre ensuite aux autres produits Cloudflare (sécurité applicative, API Shield, Workers, IA), selon la progression et l'intérêt de la personne. La sécurité de l'IA s'appuie largement sur Cloudflare One, ce qui fait de ce poste une porte d'entrée naturelle vers les projets IA de Brixio.

  • Rémunération fixe selon profil, plus une part variable liée à des objectifs projet (qualité, respect des délais, saisie des temps).
  • Certifications Cloudflare prises en charge.
  • Projets variés chez des grands comptes, des ETI et les entités d'un groupe international.
  • Une équipe à taille humaine, avec la solidité du groupe Equans.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Entretien de présentation avec le cabinet de recrutement.
  2. Entretien technique avec l'architecte principal, avec un cas pratique SASE (migration VPN vers ZTNA).

Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

About the team

Regulatory & Compliance is where we build the trust, discipline, and operational resilience required to scale a generational financial platform.

As Airwallex grows across 30+ markets, this team turns regulatory complexity into strategic control. You'll lead compliance, enterprise risk, and regulatory engagement in a way that protects the business while letting it move with conviction. Our ambition goes beyond meeting expectations: we're building a risk posture that acts as a competitive moat, grounded in ownership, proactive regulatory partnerships, and frameworks that scale globally while respecting local nuance.

It's a team for strategic operators with sharp judgment, high standards, and the confidence to execute at pace in a high-stakes environment. You'll thrive here if you can balance rigor with progress and influence across functions.

If you want to architect the benchmark for trust and resilience in global finance, your work here will have a massive impact.

What you'll do

As the Senior Manager, Financial Crime Investigations & Intelligence, you’ll lead proactive, complex, and high-risk anti-money laundering and financial crime investigations across Airwallex’s global financial infrastructure. You’ll act as an investigative subject-matter expert and operational lead, helping identify and mitigate risks across cross-border payments, corporate accounts, cards, FX and embedded finance.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead end-to-end investigations into complex financial crime typologies involving cross-border payment flows, multi-currency corporate accounts, complex ownership structures, cross-product financial-crime risks, KYB/UBO considerations and high-risk corridors.

  • Oversee case intake, triage, prioritisation and assignment for special investigations, ensuring matters requiring enhanced investigative expertise are resolved thoroughly and within established SLAs.

  • Lead financial-crime-related internal fraud and insider-threat investigations where employees or insiders may be involved in fraud, collusion with external parties, misuse of access or other conduct with a financial-crime nexus. Partner with Fraud, Infosec, People/HR, Employment Legal and senior management. Provide evidence-based findings and risk-based recommendations.

  • Analyse layered international transactions across payment rails including SWIFT, local clearing rails, card schemes and alternative payment methods to trace illicit fund movements, identify beneficial owners and uncover hidden counterparty networks.

  • Provide investigative analysis, suspect and typology recommendations, quality assurance and escalation support for SAR/STR cases, enabling MLROs to make final filing decisions in accordance with local requirements.

  • Translate investigative findings into actionable feedback for Risk, Data and Engineering teams to calibrate transaction monitoring rules, improve automated detection models and address control vulnerabilities.

  • Develop and maintain financial-crime typologies, investigative intelligence and threat assessment based on internal investigations, external intelligence, and regulatory guidance; translate these insights into control improvements, targeted training and intelligence briefings.

  • Partner with Transaction Monitoring, Onboarding and EDD, Sanctions, Fraud, Legal and regional MLROs to address systemic threats and implement coordinated risk-mitigation measures.

  • Build and maintain investigative playbooks, investigative analysis, typology context and case documentation standards and quality-assurance frameworks tailored to B2B fintech, complex law-enforcement referrals, regulatory information request, partner-bank inquiries and partner due-diligence reviews..

  • Support internal audits, independent reviews and regulatory inquiries with clear documentation, case files and briefings on investigative methodologies and outcomes.

  • Provide day-to-day guidance, peer reviews and typology training to investigators and analysts across the broader Financial Crime Compliance team.

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.
