jobs.title: Director of Cybersecurity & IT
jobs.description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

Back Market is looking for a Director of Cybersecurity & IT to define and lead the next phase of our security and technology operations maturity. Reporting to the VP of Platform Engineering, you will be a strategic leader at the intersection of cybersecurity, IT, risk, compliance, and business growth.

You will lead a multi-disciplinary organization through its existing functional managers, creating the clarity, operating rhythm, and investment focus needed to protect Back Market while enabling the company to move quickly. The scope includes cybersecurity strategy and risk management, security operations, governance and compliance, IT operations, IT support, and the corporate technology foundations that keep our people productive and our business resilient.

 

This is a director-level role, not a super-sized operational manager role. You will not be expected to personally own every process or make every technical decision. Your impact will come from setting direction, developing leaders, aligning stakeholders, making sound investment choices, and ensuring that the organization delivers measurable outcomes. You will be the senior voice who makes cybersecurity and IT understandable, actionable, and connected to the business.

 

To know more about our engineering teams:

  • A video of our VP Platform: https://youtu.be/zvTlw4BNNdc

  • Our company purpose: http://bit.ly/3OsScpl

  • Our engineering blog: https://bit.ly/3ASJNID

How we work with the existing teams 💚

 

The Director sets direction, creates clarity, secures resources, removes organizational obstacles, develops leaders, and ensures that the overall portfolio delivers against agreed outcomes. The functional managers and senior experts retain ownership of day-to-day execution, technical practices, operational processes, and delivery within their domains. The Director creates the conditions for those leaders to succeed and makes sure their work adds up to a coherent company-wide strategy.

Your next missions 👇

 

Set the strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities

  • Define and evolve a multi-year Cybersecurity & IT strategy aligned with Back Market's business goals, risk appetite, technology strategy, and growth plans

  • Translate that strategy into a focused portfolio of initiatives, with clear outcomes, sequencing, ownership, dependencies, and measures of success

  • Own the operating rhythm for the full scope: planning, budgeting, program tracking, KPI and SLA reporting, risk reviews, and executive communication

  • Make pragmatic investment and prioritization recommendations, balancing resilience, customer trust, regulatory expectations, employee experience, and engineering velocity

  • Establish the governance forums and decision mechanisms needed to keep priorities clear and accountability visible

 

Lead and grow a high-performing leadership organization

  • Lead through the managers and senior individual contributors responsible for Security Operations, Governance Risk & Compliance, IT Operations Engineering, IT Support, and relevant security engineering or product security capabilities

  • Coach, challenge, and develop your leaders, helping them grow their scope, judgment, influence, and ability to build strong teams of their own

  • Create clear career paths, succession plans, and development opportunities across the organization

  • Build a high-trust environment where teams have genuine ownership, collaborate across boundaries, and are encouraged to improve how work gets done

  • Attract and retain exceptional talent, define what great leadership and execution look like, and continuously raise the bar without creating unnecessary bureaucracy

  • Ensure that responsibilities, decision rights, and interfaces between the teams are explicit, understood, and respected

 

Turn cybersecurity into a business enabler

  • Act as a trusted advisor to the VP of Engineering, CTO, Executive Committee, and senior leaders across the business

  • Explain complex security, IT, and risk topics in clear business language, including the trade-offs, options, costs, and consequences of different decisions

  • Engage with Heads of and cross-functional streams across Back Market to advocate for security and resilience in all areas of the business

  • Build alignment rather than relying on authority, and help teams adopt secure and resilient ways of working because they understand the rationale and value

  • Partner with Finance and senior technology leadership on investment cases, budget stewardship, vendor strategy, and the value delivered by the portfolio

 

Steer enterprise cyber risk and trust

  • Own the cyber risk management process at the strategic level, using the GRC framework as the foundation for security decisions and prioritization

  • Ensure that material risks, control gaps, exceptions, and remediation plans are visible, understood, and actively managed

  • Escalate critical risks when they exceed the organization's risk appetite or require executive arbitration

  • Support security compliance efforts across the organization, ensuring alignment and buy-in from peers and key stakeholders across ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, NIS2, and contractual partner requirements

  • Partner with the VP Legal and DPO on the company's data privacy strategy, ensuring privacy and security requirements are considered early in business, product, and technology decisions

  • Represent Back Market's security maturity and risk posture to investors, auditors, regulators, strategic partners, and major customers

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for major or complex security incidents, ensuring the right executive communication, decision-making, learning, and follow-through without displacing the operational ownership of the incident response teams

 

Enable secure products and resilient technology

  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and other Bureau of Technology directors to ensure security requirements are integrated into product and feature development from the beginning

  • Sponsor and evolve Product Security and secure software development lifecycle practices, including security-by-design, threat modeling, appropriate testing, and pragmatic guardrails

  • Ensure the security roadmap addresses the most important risks across cloud infrastructure, corporate systems, identity and access, endpoints, applications, data, and third-party services

  • Set the expectations for Security Operations across threat intelligence, vulnerability management, security monitoring, incident readiness, risk assessment and project design reviews, fraud support, AI security, and associated SLA and KPI tracking

  • Ensure IT Operations and IT Support provide a reliable, scalable, and high-quality experience for Back Makers across our global offices and remote workforce

  • Champion automation, standardization, and engineering-led approaches that reduce manual work and improve reliability, while leaving day-to-day technical ownership with the appropriate functional teams

 

Build security culture and external credibility

  • Foster a security-aware culture through clear communication about the evolving threat landscape, key initiatives, practical expectations, and the role every Back Maker plays in protecting the company

  • Sponsor awareness, education, and Security Champion programs that make secure behavior accessible and relevant to different audiences

  • Represent Back Market in relevant security communities, industry groups, partner forums, and regulatory conversations

  • Build trusted relationships with strategic technology partners, auditors, insurers, and external security providers

  • Help Back Market demonstrate that strong security, responsible technology, and business agility reinforce one another


You could be a good fit if you've:

  • A proven track record of building, scaling, and developing organizations that span multiple security and/or IT domains

  • 12 to 15+ years of experience across cybersecurity, information security, IT, or related technology leadership roles, including at least 5 years leading managers and multi-team organizations

  • Experience operating as a strategic partner to a CTO, VP Engineering, executive committee, or equivalent senior leadership group

  • Proven expertise and a solid grasp of the domains listed below: security operations, cyber risk and governance, compliance and assurance, security architecture, product security, cloud security, IT operations, or corporate technology

  • Demonstrated ability to turn business strategy and risk appetite into a practical security and IT roadmap, investment plan, and operating model

  • Experience communicating security and technology risk to executive, board-level, investor, partner, audit, and non-technical audiences

  • A mature, risk-based approach. You understand that perfect security does not exist, and that good leadership means making explicit, informed trade-offs and focusing resources where they have the greatest impact

  • Experience leading through managers and senior experts, with a genuine passion for developing people, building leadership capability, and creating meaningful career paths

  • Strong understanding of modern cloud, SaaS, identity, endpoint, application, data, and infrastructure security concepts, even if you are not the deepest technical expert in every domain

  • Experience with security-by-design, secure software development lifecycle practices, and effective partnership with Engineering and Product teams

  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to make complex topics clear, concrete, and compelling. French is a plus

  • The judgment, calm, and influence required to operate effectively in ambiguity, during incidents, and across competing stakeholder priorities

  • Genuine excitement about Back Market's mission and the belief that cybersecurity and IT are essential enablers of sustainable growth

    Nice to have

  • A recognized certification such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, CCSP, or an equivalent professional qualification

  • Experience with ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, NIS2, or other relevant European regulatory and assurance frameworks

  • Experience with GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, modern cloud-native security tooling, or SaaS-first environments

  • Experience in marketplace, e-commerce, fintech, or another business with meaningful customer, partner, or regulatory trust requirements

  • Experience with AI security, fraud prevention, third-party risk, or software supply chain security

  • Experience working in a fast-growing, international organization with distributed

    Hiring process

    1. Phone call with Marie, Technical Talent Acquisition Partner - 45 min

    2. Deep-dive interview on Leadership and management with your future manager, the VP of Engineering - 60 min

    3. Meeting a peer Engineering Director and an Engineering Manager - 60 min

    4. Technical interview with Cybersec and IT team - 45 min

    5. Stakeholder interview with cross-functional partners, including the CTO and relevant Security and IT leaders - 60 min

    6. Cultural and Values interview with a C-level leader from Back Market - 45 min

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

jobs.title: Director, Product-Led Growth
Product Line Manager
jobs.description:
About Wallee Group AG

Wallee Group is a leader in advanced payment solutions, dedicated to providing robust, scalable, and secure systems across multiple domains. We enhance customer experiences through innovative payment and finance technology that empowers businesses to grow efficiently. With operations spanning several countries, we thrive on collaboration and agility, utilizing the Scrum framework to drive our international teams. At Wallee, we stay at the forefront of market trends, continuously innovating to deliver premier services to our global customers.

The Role

The Product Line Manager owns the full lifecycle of a product line - from introduction through to controlled end-of-life. The role combines strategic portfolio and roadmap management with subject matter expertise in specific verticals, bringing market, product, and supplier perspectives into one consistent strategy.

In Wallee's payment technology context, this specifically includes managing hardware/firmware generations (e.g., terminal models, certification versions like the EMV L2 kernel) and forward-looking planning for successor products.

The Impact You’ll Make

  • Drive Full Lifecycle & Strategy: Own the product journey from concept to decommissioning—defining launch criteria, target segments, success metrics, and forward-looking successor products before hardware/firmware generation changes.

  • Optimize the Portfolio: Maintain a structured view of all variants (terminal types, SoftPOS vs. hardware POS) using frameworks like the BCG matrix to prioritize investment and avoid overlap/cannibalization.

  • Build Capacity-Synced Roadmaps: Translate strategic goals and vertical needs into prioritized, time-boxed feature roadmaps (e.g., quarterly or PI planning in SAFe), balancing "run the business" compliance updates against "grow the business" initiatives.

  • Champion Vertical Expertise & Research: Act as the "translator" between vertical requirements (e.g., retail, hospitality, events) and engineering's technical language while running ongoing trend scanning (PCI/EMV updates), competitor analysis, and customer feedback synthesis.

  • Lead Go-to-Market & Sales Enablement: Define launch plans (positioning, pricing, training, documentation), coordinate alignment across Sales, Marketing, and Support, and assist Sales with technical expertise on complex, regulated deals.

  • Manage Suppliers & Ecosystems: Onboard and manage external partners (terminal manufacturers, component suppliers, certification labs), overseeing SLAs, operational forecasting, defect escalations, contract negotiations, and risk mitigation (such as dual-sourcing).

What Success Looks Like

  • Strategic Portfolio Health: A clear, non-overlapping product line where investments are prioritized effectively and End-of-Sale (EOS) / End-of-Life (EOL) migration paths are seamlessly executed.

  • Uncompromising Compliance: Continuous alignment with certification and regulatory standards (PCI, EMV, ep2) across the entire portfolio, eliminating compliance risk.

  • Reliable Supplier Alignment: High-performing partner relationships with well-managed SLAs, aligned roadmaps, and secure supply chains.

  • Market-Driven Innovation: Roadmaps and GTM materials that accurately reflect vertical user journeys, market trends, and validated customer needs.

  • Cross-Functional Readiness: Seamless coordination with internal teams so all departments are aligned and fully enabled from day one of product launches.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Product Experience: Proven experience in product management, ideally with portfolio or product line ownership in fintech, payments, or hardware-enabled software.

  • Domain Knowledge: Understanding or familiarity with payment certification and compliance topics (PCI, EMV, ep2) is a strong plus.

  • Vertical & Market Expertise: Experience or strong interest in specific industry verticals, coupled with a track record in market research and competitor analysis.

  • Strategic & Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with a solution- and customer-oriented approach.

  • Stakeholder & Supplier Management: Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, comfortable managing both internal stakeholders and external supplier relationships.

  • Languages: Fluent in English and German.

Why Join Wallee?

  • Modern Workspace: A beautiful office in the heart of Winterthur - comfortable, bright, and collaboration-ready.

  • True Flexibility: Flexible daily hours and a 4-week "Work from Anywhere" policy every year.

  • Innovation First: We work with the latest tech stacks in a flat hierarchy where your voice actually matters.

  • Growth & Culture: Competitive compensation, aligned with experience, seniority, and expertise, personal development budgets, and a social calendar filled with events.

  • The Perks: Fresh fruits, snacks, and high-quality coffee to keep you fueled.

Don’t tick every box? Neither do most great hires. If the role feels right, reach out, we’d love to see if we’re a match.

jobs.title: Medior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Ben jij een Software Engineer die graag zelfstandig bouwt aan slimme, schaalbare software? Wil je technische uitdagingen oplossen, meedenken over nieuwe functionaliteiten en jezelf blijven ontwikkelen binnen een ervaren productteam? Dan is deze functie bij BAS World iets voor jou!

Bij BAS World ontwikkelen we digitale producten waarmee klanten wereldwijd trucks, trailers, machines en onderdelen kunnen kopen en verkopen. Onze software ondersteunt internationale handelsprocessen en wordt dagelijks gebruikt door klanten en collega's over de hele wereld.

Als Medior Software Engineer werk je binnen een van onze productteams aan betrouwbare en schaalbare software. Je pakt zelfstandig technische vraagstukken op, denkt mee over de beste oplossingen en bent betrokken bij het volledige ontwikkelproces: van het begrijpen van het probleem tot het bouwen, testen en onderhouden van de oplossing.

Je werkt nauw samen met andere Engineers, Product Owners en collega's vanuit de business. Daarbij krijg je de ruimte om technische keuzes te maken, nieuwe ideeën aan te dragen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Medior Software Engineer werk je aan digitale producten die direct bijdragen aan de groei van BAS World. Je schrijft niet alleen code, maar denkt ook actief mee over hoe we onze software en processen kunnen verbeteren.

Je werkt binnen een van onze vijf productpijlers: Operations, Parts & Tyres, Buyer, Seller of Platform Engineering. Samen met jouw team ontwikkel je oplossingen die waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten en collega's.

Jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Je ontwerpt, ontwikkelt en onderhoudt schaalbare en betrouwbare software;

  • Je pakt zelfstandig nieuwe functionaliteiten en technische vraagstukken op, van analyse tot implementatie en beheer;

  • Je werkt samen met Product Owners, Engineers en collega's vanuit de business om klantbehoeften te vertalen naar technische oplossingen;

  • Je denkt mee tijdens de discoveryfase, onderzoekt verschillende oplossingsrichtingen en test ideeën waar nodig met prototypes;

  • Je schrijft leesbare, testbare en onderhoudbare code en draagt bij aan de kwaliteit, beveiliging en betrouwbaarheid van onze software;

  • Je voert code reviews uit, werkt samen via pair programming en deelt actief kennis met collega's;

  • Je onderzoekt en verhelpt incidenten en denkt mee over structurele oplossingen;

  • Je signaleert technische verbeterkansen en experimenteert met nieuwe technologieën en moderne engineeringtools.

Je krijgt de vrijheid om zelfstandig aan oplossingen te werken, maar staat er nooit alleen voor. Je leert van ervaren collega's, deelt jouw eigen kennis en werkt samen aan producten die dagelijks wereldwijd worden gebruikt.

Wat maakt deze functie zo interessant?

Bij BAS World werk je niet alleen aan technische oplossingen, maar denk je ook mee over de ontwikkeling van onze digitale producten. Je krijgt de ruimte om kritische vragen te stellen, ideeën te testen en invloed uit te oefenen op technische keuzes.

Je werkt in een productgedreven organisatie waar we continu zoeken naar manieren om onze software slimmer, sneller en betrouwbaarder te maken.

Of je nu nieuwe functionaliteiten ontwikkelt, bestaande systemen verbetert of experimenteert met AI en cloud-native technologie: je krijgt volop mogelijkheden om jezelf technisch verder te ontwikkelen en steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid te nemen.

Wij bieden jou

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris dat past bij jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen;

  • Een goede pensioenregeling;

  • Veel zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid binnen een ervaren productteam;

  • De mogelijkheid om te werken aan digitale producten die wereldwijd worden gebruikt;

  • Volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen via interne en externe opleidingen;

  • De vrijheid om te experimenteren met AI, cloud-native technologie en moderne engineeringtools;

  • Directe samenwerking met ervaren Engineers, Product Owners en andere technische specialisten;

  • De keuze tussen een MacBook of Windows-laptop;

  • Een informele, internationale werkomgeving met korte lijnen en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.


Jouw specificaties

We zoeken een Software Engineer die zelfstandig kan werken, graag technische uitdagingen aangaat en verder kijkt dan alleen het schrijven van code.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je hebt ervaring als Software Engineer en kunt zelfstandig nieuwe functionaliteiten en technische oplossingen ontwikkelen;

  • Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werk, van het ontwerp tot een betrouwbare werking in productie;

  • Je schrijft leesbare, testbare en onderhoudbare code;

  • Je denkt mee over technische keuzes en weet jouw ideeën en oplossingen duidelijk uit te leggen;

  • Je werkt graag samen met collega's, staat open voor feedback en deelt actief jouw kennis;

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe technologieën en denkt graag mee over verbeteringen;

  • Je werkt minimaal vier dagen per week vanuit ons kantoor in Veghel, zodat je nauw kunt samenwerken met jouw team.

Daarnaast heb je ervaring met meerdere van de volgende technologieën en werkwijzen:

  • PHP, Laravel en/of andere moderne frontend- en backendtechnologieën;

  • Cloud-native softwareontwikkeling, bij voorkeur binnen AWS;

  • API's, data-uitwisseling en gedistribueerde systemen;

  • CI/CD, geautomatiseerd testen en databases;

  • Softwarearchitectuur, observability, security en schaalbaarheid.

Je hoeft niet overal expert in te zijn. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je een goede technische basis hebt, zelfstandig kunt werken en gemotiveerd bent om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

Interesse?

Wil jij bouwen aan digitale producten die wereldwijd worden gebruikt en jezelf verder ontwikkelen als Software Engineer? Solliciteer dan direct en ontdek jouw mogelijkheden bij BAS World!

Wij zijn BAS!

BAS is een internationaal familiebedrijf dat sinds 1962 actief is in de automotive-sector. Met meer dan 1.000 collega's zijn we wereldwijd actief in de handel en het onderhoud van vrachtwagens, trekkers, trailers, bouwmachines, bedrijfswagens en landbouwmachines.

Via ons platform basworld.com brengen we kopers en verkopers van over de hele wereld samen. Onze ambitie is om uit te groeien tot de toonaangevende wereldwijde marktplaats voor gebruikte commerciële voertuigen en machines.

Binnen BAS World werken onze Product- en Tech-teams dagelijks aan de ontwikkeling en verbetering van onze digitale producten. We werken productgedreven en volgens agile principes, waarbij we nieuwe ideeën onderzoeken, testen en ontwikkelen om zo snel mogelijk waarde toe te voegen voor onze gebruikers.

Bij BAS houden we van aanpakken, samenwerken en kansen benutten. Brabantse nuchterheid, passie, teamwork en ondernemerschap vormen de basis van onze organisatie. Samen blijven we groeien en onze digitale dienstverlening verbeteren!

jobs.description:
Print & Copy Channel Business Unit

Locatie:

Deze hybride functie biedt de flexibiliteit om zowel vanuit ons kantoor in Almere als vanuit huis te werken.

Rapporteert aan:

Cluster Manager (Primair & Commercieel) en IT Manager (Technisch & functioneel)

Scope:

Ondersteuning voor Single cluster (BnNe-regio)

Over ITS

Info Technology Supply Ltd (ITS) is een gerenommeerd softwarebedrijf met meer dan 38 jaar ervaring in de print- en documentmanagementindustrie in Europa en Noord- en Zuid-Amerika. Onze Business Unit Print & Copy Channel distribueert exclusief softwareoplossingen van toonaangevende leveranciers en ondersteunt een uitgebreid netwerk van meer dan 2.000 resellers en partners, verdeeld over zes regionale clusters.

Als het grootste PaperCut Authorised Solution Centre van Europa beschikken wij over een uitgebreid portfolio, waaronder PaperCut MF, NG, Hive en Pocket, evenals Umango, Willow360 en DocSlide. Daarnaast ontwikkelen wij diverse aanvullende modules die onze oplossingen verder versterken en uitbreiden.

Met vestigingen en activiteiten in het Verenigd Koninkrijk, Spanje, Nederland, België, Frankrijk, de DACH-regio en Oost-Europa zijn wij een werkelijk internationale organisatie. Tegelijkertijd behouden wij de persoonlijke betrokkenheid, korte lijnen en warme familiecultuur die ons al jarenlang kenmerken.

De Kans

Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende functie binnen een dynamische en snelgroeiende omgeving? Dan is dit jouw kans om je technische expertise verder te ontwikkelen en onderdeel te worden van het Technical Services Team van een internationaal en innovatief softwarebedrijf.

Voor deze functie zoeken wij een enthousiaste en nauwkeurige professional met een proactieve instelling en een sterk probleemoplossend vermogen. Je bent in staat om klanten hoogwaardige technische ondersteuning te bieden en hen te begeleiden bij de implementatie en het beheer van onze oplossingen voor print-, scan- en documentmanagement.

Je werkt hierbij onder andere met producten uit ons portfolio, waaronder PaperCut, Umango, DocSlide en diverse andere innovatieve softwareoplossingen.

Belangrijkste Verantwoordelijkheden

Customer Support (Klantenondersteuning)

1. Het bieden van technische ondersteuning via de helpdesk, telefonisch, e-mail en via remote sessies en incidenteel onsite bij partners en/of eindklanten.

  8. Het creëren en uitvoeren van praktische technische trainingen en workshops voor partners.


Internal IT

1. Assisteren bij technische support aan collega's op zowel de software als de hardware die het bedrijf gebruikt.

2. Ondersteuning van de interne infrastructuur en diensten.

Vereiste kwalificaties

Ervaring & Achtergrond

  1. Uitstekende mondelinge en schriftelijke beheersing van het Nederlands en een goede beheersing van het Engels.
  2. Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om gemakkelijk een goede relatie op te bouwen met klanten.
  3. Ervaring met print management oplossingen, zoals "Papercut" of scanoplossingen, is meegenomen.


4. Ervaring met Microsoft Windows Server- en clientplatformen, Active Directory, Entra ID en Microsoft SQL Server.

5. Ervaring met Windows-printservers, printwachtrijen en het uitrollen van printerdrivers is een pré.

6. Gedegen kennis van netwerken (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, firewallpoorten en SNMP) voor het oplossen van communicatieproblemen tussen servers, clients en printers.

7. Sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden, met een gestructureerde aanpak van complexe technische vraagstukken.

8. Een proactieve instelling en het vermogen om nieuwe technologieën snel en zelfstandig eigen te maken.

9. In staat om zowel zelfstandig als effectief binnen een team te werken.

  1. Kan zowel zelfstandig als in team werken.


Pré

  1. Eerdere ervaring in een functie op het gebied van klantenservice of technische ondersteuning.
  2. Kennis van PaperCut-functionaliteiten zoals Find-Me Printing, Print Deploy, Mobility Print en scanworkflows (scan-to-email, scan-to-folder en scan-to-cloud).
  3. Ervaring met het configureren van embedded software en kaartlezers op multifunctionele printers van merken zoals Canon, Ricoh, Konica Minolta, Kyocera of HP.
  4. Ervaring met andere print- en scanmanagementoplossingen, zoals Equitrac, uniFLOW of YSoft SAFEQ.
  5. Een PaperCut-certificering, bijvoorbeeld PaperCut Certified Engineer.
  6. Ervaring met virtualisatieplatformen en Microsoft Azure.
  7. Bekendheid met macOS en Linux.


Wat wij aanbieden

Wij geloven dat plezier in je werk net zo belangrijk is als goede arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Daarom bieden wij:

1. Een uitdagende functie binnen een internationale organisatie.

2. Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid.

3. Hybride werken vanuit huis en/of ons kantoor in Almere.

4. Een auto van de zaak.

5. Laptop en telefoon van de zaak.

6. Een aantrekkelijk salaris passend bij jouw ervaring.

7. 25 vakantiedagen.

8. Uitgebreide opleidingen, trainingen en certificeringsmogelijkheden.

9. Een team van collega's dat elkaar ondersteunt en kennis deelt.

10. Ruimte om door te groeien richting consultancy, projectmanagement of specialistische technische rollen.

Bedrijfsbeschrijving

ITS Benelux maakt deel uit van de internationale ITS Group, een organisatie die al meer dan 35 jaar actief is en klanten ondersteunt in Europa, Noord-Amerika en daarbuiten.

Maar wat je vooral merkt als collega, is dat we ondanks onze internationale omvang een nuchtere en persoonlijke organisatie zijn gebleven.

We werken hard, helpen elkaar, vieren successen samen en geloven dat de beste ideeën ontstaan wanneer mensen zich prettig voelen op hun werk.

Hier ben je geen nummer, maar een belangrijk onderdeel van het team.

Voel je vrij om its-group.com en printandcopycontrol.com te bezoeken om meer te weten te komen over ons bedrijf en productportfolio.

iTS is gecertificeerd volgens de ISO 9001:2015- en ISO/IEC 27001:2022-normen.

Bedrijfswaarden

Klantgericht: We streven ernaar om te zorgen dat aan de behoeften van onze klanten worden voldaan en overtroffen, en bouwen sterke, langdurige relaties op.

Flexibel & Loyaal: We investeren tijd, energie en middelen in het koesteren van onze relaties, met als doel langdurig succes.

Internationaal team met een gezinsgeest: Onze bedrijfscultuur hecht waarde aan samenwerking, waardering en persoonlijke ontwikkeling, en biedt een waardevolle omgeving waar iedereen kan floreren.

ITS is niet:

Arrogant

Arrogantie laat mensen geloven dat ze altijd het beste weten. Het stopt het constante leren dat succes vereist. Wij zien arrogantie als het begin van het einde van elke organisatie.

Om te solliciteren

Denk je dat dit bij je past?

Mooi. Dan hoeven we niet per se een perfect CV te zien.

Ben jij technisch nieuwsgierig, klantgericht en heb je zin om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen een internationale organisatie? Dan gaan we graag met je in gesprek.

Graag ontvangen wij jouw cv, inclusief een motivatiebrief waarin je beschrijft:

1. Je praktische technische ervaring met PaperCut of andere producten binnen het ITS-portfolio, inclusief de omgevingen waarin je deze hebt geïmplementeerd, ondersteund of beheerd.

2. Voorbeelden van technische, presales- en adviesactiviteiten waaraan je hebt bijgedragen of die je hebt geleid, zoals solution design, productdemonstraties en aanbestedingstrajecten.

3. Je taalvaardigheden en, indien van toepassing, je kennis van de clusterregio en het bijbehorende partnernetwerk.

iTS is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt en zich inzet voor het opbouwen van een divers en inclusief team.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

The Role

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to join our Revenue Operations team and act as a broad, senior partner to our revenue organization. You'll set and execute the strategy for how we build revenue analytics across Salesforce and Looker, run insights that shape how revenue leadership sees the business, partner closely with revenue leadership on the full range of topics they face, and, as you ramp up, take on growing ownership of the forecasting cadence alongside the Director of Revenue Operations.

This is a generalist role by design: analytics is the foundation, especially in your first two quarters, and the role broadens from there to include business partnering and forecasting. What matters most is the versatility to move across all three, not depth in any single one.


What You'll Do

  • First 90 days: Scope the revenue analytics strategy and build the core dashboards.

  • First 180 days: Build a highly automated revenue insights engine using AI, while establishing yourself as the business partner revenue leadership.

  • First 12 months: Broaden into leading and supporting the forecasting cadence.


What Will You Be Doing?

Revenue Analytics & Insights

  • Partner with the Director of Revenue Operations to define the revenue analytics strategy: what we need to build across Salesforce and Looker, and in what order.

  • Map the current reporting landscape — what exists, what's trusted, what's duplicated or out of date — and use that map to shape the build plan.

  • Own execution of that plan: build and maintain the core dashboards and reports that revenue leadership and the wider revenue leadership team rely on.

  • Launch and run a recurring insights digest for revenue leaders, turning dashboards and data into a clear narrative — what changed, why it matters, what to do about it.

  • Bring a point of view on what's worth building versus what's noise, and be willing to push back on requests that don't earn their keep.

Business Partnership to Revenue leadership

  • Become the go-to Revenue Operations partner for revenue leadership, covering reporting, insights, and the broader range of topics that come up in running a sales organization.

  • Translate revenue leadership's open questions into structured analysis and clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Represent revenue's priorities into the Revenue Operations roadmap, and vice versa.

  • Support revenue leaders in business reviews, planning moments, and ad hoc requests with credible, fast turnaround.

Forecasting

  • Run the forecasting cadence with sales leaders alongside the Director of Revenue Operations — forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and accuracy tracking.

  • Build and refine forecasting models based on pipeline, productivity, and historical conversion.

  • Conduct strategic analyses to determine forecasting trends and identify opportunities for process improvement.


What Will You Need to Succeed?

  • 5+ years of experience in Revenue or Sales Operations, preferably in a SaaS or technology company operating at a global or European level.

  • Exposure to Account Executive (AE) or similarly quota-carrying organization.

  • Strong Salesforce reporting skills and working fluency in a BI tool (Looker or equivalent), with a practical, business-first approach to data.

  • A genuine generalist mindset — as comfortable building a dashboard or an insights report, as running a forecasting call.

  • A track record of setting direction and quality bar for analytical work.

  • Strong stakeholder management, with the ability to work with and influence sales leadership and revenue executives.

  • Comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end: framing the question, choosing the method, landing the recommendation.

  • Excellent written communication — the insights digest is a core, ongoing deliverable of this role.

  • Experience partnering with global or multi-region teams is a plus.


What we Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

We're an Amsterdam-based team of 95+ (and counting) with 20+ nationalities amongst us! A varied bunch of “Citizens of The World” with a wide range of skills and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our travel belts. And we have something important in common (other than our very well-worn passports): We want to change the way people travel.

And that's exactly what we're doing, with the travel app to plan, track, and relive trips in a smart and beautiful way.

Polarsteps has over 22 million users already, but, for us, this is just the beginning. We have big plans for the future, and so we need even more talented and enthusiastic people to help us on our journey.

Want to know more about us? Here you go.

Your expedition: Product Design at Polarsteps

We’re a small team, doing big things.

At Polarsteps, everyone, our CEO, support specialists, developers, product managers, and more, cares about design. It’s part of our DNA and embedded in every discussion. This gives you, as a Product Designer, the opportunity to make full use of your skills and craft your designs to perfection.

Our relatively small team consists of like-minded design enthusiasts who can geek out over the nitty-gritty details–corner radius, shadows, colors–for hours. We are big on collaboration, challenge each other, and make meetings as fun as they are productive. We dream big, move fast and welcome ideas, from anyone.

Your itinerary

What your journey at Polarsteps will look like on a typical day.

Lead the design of our “Digital Relive” team, focused on one of travel’s most meaningful moments: looking back on it all. We’re building new ways for travelers to relive their trips, both on the road and once they’re home, from in-app experiences to shareable formats like Trip Reels and Map Video.

✅ Experience in prototyping tools such as Principle/Protopie or similar;
✅ Skills in partnering with engineers to drive QA processes and uphold implementation fidelity;
✅ A genuine interest in motion, video, and visual storytelling, and the curiosity to grow in it. You don’t need to be an After Effects pro, but you get excited about how things move and feel.

Bonus points if you have:

✨ Hands-on experience with motion or video tools (like After Effects or Premiere), or with designing for social platforms like Instagram and TikTok. Not a dealbreaker if that’s not your world yet; it’s something we’re happy to grow together.

 

1st class extras

We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to build Camunda’s Dutch Government market. This is a territory-building role for a disciplined, consultative seller who can create demand, shape strategic opportunities, and guide complex buying groups through to executive-level decisions. You will own the full sales cycle across a focused set of government accounts, from account strategy and first conversation through business case, procurement, negotiation, close, and expansion.

You will combine commercial ownership with public-sector credibility. The successful candidate will be comfortable engaging senior civil servants, CIO and transformation leaders, procurement, security, architecture, and business stakeholders. You will translate government priorities into a compelling value case for process orchestration, automation, and agentic workflows, while navigating formal procurement processes and the governance expectations of public-sector customers.

What you will own

  • Own the Dutch Government territory and create a clear account and coverage strategy across priority national and public-sector organizations.

  • Build and maintain a healthy, self-generated pipeline, targeting at least 2.5x pipeline coverage through focused outbound activity, executive engagement, partner collaboration, and market development.

  • Apply MEDDICC consistently to create deal clarity, strengthen qualification, identify gaps early, and improve forecast reliability.

What success looks like

First 30 days

  • Build a working understanding of Camunda’s platform, value proposition, sales methodology, customer evidence, pricing approach, and public-sector references.

  • Align with internal stakeholders on territory priorities, account ownership, partner coverage, and available sales resources.

  • Produce an initial account segmentation and stakeholder-mapping plan for the Dutch Government territory.

  • Establish a repeatable operating cadence for pipeline creation, deal inspection, forecasting, and cross-functional account-team collaboration.

First 90 days

  • Complete strategic account plans for the highest-priority government accounts, including business priorities, buying groups, whitespace, partners, competition, and next actions.

  • Create qualified pipeline through a balanced mix of net-new opportunities, partner-sourced activity, executive introductions, and expansion plays.

  • Develop a strong network of relevant government and ecosystem stakeholders, with clear relationship and meeting objectives.

  • Demonstrate consistent MEDDICC qualification and accurate Salesforce hygiene across active opportunities.

  • Identify the most relevant public-sector use cases and value narratives for Camunda’s Dutch market development.

First 180 days and beyond

  • Establish a credible, repeatable pipeline engine for the Dutch Government market.

  • Progress strategic opportunities through well-defined qualification, value validation, technical evaluation, procurement, and commercial stages.

  • Win new government logos and create expansion paths into additional departments, agencies, or processes.

  • Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors and public-sector ecosystem partners.

  • Contribute actionable market insight that improves Camunda’s positioning, messaging, partner strategy, and investment decisions in the Netherlands.

  • Deliver against quota while protecting long-term customer value, adoption, and expansion potential.

What you will bring

Must-haves

  • 5+ years of success in a quota-carrying enterprise software or SaaS Account Executive role, owning complex deals end to end.

  • Demonstrated experience selling into the Dutch Government or another highly regulated public-sector environment, with a clear understanding of formal procurement, security, legal, and governance requirements.

  • A track record of creating pipeline through proactive outbound activity and converting multi-stakeholder opportunities into material, preferably multi-year, contracts.

  • Strong command of MEDDICC or a comparable enterprise sales methodology, with the discipline to qualify rigorously, manage mutual action plans, and forecast accurately.

  • Executive presence and communication skills in Dutch and English, with the ability to connect operational problems to strategic, financial, and citizen-impact outcomes.

  • A collaborative, customer-focused, and resilient approach aligned with Camunda’s FAITH values and global-first way of working.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience selling process automation, workflow, orchestration, integration, business transformation, or adjacent enterprise technology.

  • Existing relationships across Dutch ministries, executive agencies, municipalities, provinces, public-service organizations, or government-focused partners.

  • Experience working with global system integrators, regional implementation partners, or public-sector framework agreements.

  • Familiarity with Camunda, BPMN, DMN, process orchestration, cloud platforms, or agentic automation.

  • Experience creating quantified value cases for service modernization, compliance, operational resilience, or cost reduction.

Why this role matters now

Dutch public-sector organizations are under pressure to modernize services, improve efficiency, operate securely, and coordinate increasingly complex technology and regulatory environments. Process orchestration gives them a way to make that complexity visible and manageable while connecting people, systems, and automation.

This role is an opportunity to shape a market rather than inherit a mature patch. You will have the ownership and visibility to define where Camunda can create the greatest public value, build the ecosystem around those opportunities, and establish a durable foundation for growth in the Netherlands.

You will join a global, distributed team that values initiative, transparency, customer impact, and practical collaboration. The role offers the chance to work at the intersection of public-sector transformation, enterprise technology, process orchestration, and the next generation of agentic automation.

At BeReal, we are dedicated to authenticity in social media. By encouraging users to share unfiltered moments, we foster genuine connections and celebrate real life.   • Swile Lunch voucher

Senior Manager, Technology Risk Assurance
jobs.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

You’ll build and scale a practical Second Line of Defence technology risk assurance function for a fast-growing, regulated fintech.

  • Recruit, mentor, and lead a lean, high-performing team of technology risk engineers and assurance specialists, fostering technical depth, code-first assurance, and cross-functional agility.

  • Lead second-line assurance across ITGCs and IT application controls, cloud infrastructure and database management, CI/CD and change enablement, IAM and privileged access, API and automated data pipeline integrity, and business continuity and disaster recovery.

  • Build an automation-first assurance engine using AI agents, automated workflows, and custom Python and SQL scripts for continuous control testing, evidence retrieval, and remediation validation.

  • Establish automated finding lifecycle and remediation governance, surfacing control failures to engineering leads and validating fixes without drawn-out re-audit cycles.

  • Design and execute control frameworks for generative AI, LLMs, agentic workflows, machine learning models, and automated decision engines.

  • Partner with external auditors and global regulators to defend autonomous testing scripts and AI-agent methodologies, ensuring automated evidence is trusted and relied upon.

  • Translate complex technology risk into clear recommendations for engineers, senior executives, and board-level risk committees, drawing on frameworks and expectations including NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 1, SOC 2, DORA, MAS TRM, FCA, HKMA, ASIC, and FinCEN.

You’ll work from our Amsterdam or London office three days a week.


What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in technology risk, IT audit, information security assurance, or technology compliance, including proven experience in a Second Line of Defence risk assurance capacity.

  • Big Four background.

  • Experience building and testing risk controls.

  • A track record of recruiting, mentoring, and leading high-performing technical risk or assurance teams.

  • Deep practical expertise in ITGCs, IT application controls, automated business controls, and SOX compliance within complex distributed architectures.

  • Hands-on experience assessing cloud risks across AWS or GCP, particularly IAM, privileged access and segregation of duties, Firefighter workflows, CI/CD pipelines, database controls, and modern API security.

  • Practical ability to write and use SQL, Python, or API scripts to query databases, automate evidence extraction, and reduce manual sampling.

  • Strong conceptual and practical understanding of risks and controls around AI/ML systems, LLMs, and automated decision engines, including data drift, access guardrails, and model integrity.

  • Proven ability to constructively challenge First Line engineering leads while maintaining the credibility to defend automated testing methodologies to external auditors and regulatory examiners.

  • Solid working knowledge of industry control frameworks such as SOC 1/2, ISO 27001, and NIST CSF.

Preferred

  • Direct experience building or deploying AI agents, LLM-driven audit assistants, or automated compliance and testing pipelines.

  • Fintech experience, particularly within a high-growth fintech, payments platform, digital bank, or cloud-native technology company.

  • People management experience.

  • Familiarity with international financial technology regulations and expectations, including MAS TRM, FCA, HKMA, DORA, ASIC, and FinCEN.

  • Experience integrating GRC platforms, BI dashboards such as Tableau or Looker, and continuous compliance monitoring tools.

  • Relevant certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CRISC, CISM, or AWS/GCP certifications.


You'll thrive here if

  • You’re comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

  • You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

  • You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.


Learn more about your team

Risk is part of Regulatory & Compliance at Airwallex.

Regulatory & Compliance is where we build the trust, discipline, and operational resilience required to scale a generational financial platform.

As Airwallex grows across 30+ markets, this team turns regulatory complexity into strategic control. You'll lead compliance, enterprise risk, and regulatory engagement in a way that protects the business while letting it move with conviction. Our ambition goes beyond meeting expectations: we're building a risk posture that acts as a competitive moat, grounded in ownership, proactive regulatory partnerships, and frameworks that scale globally while respecting local nuance.

It's a team for strategic operators with sharp judgment, high standards, and the confidence to execute at pace in a high-stakes environment. You'll thrive here if you can balance rigor with progress and influence across functions.

If you want to architect the benchmark for trust and resilience in global finance, your work here will have a massive impact.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

At SINGU, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

 

Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide, supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.

 

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

 

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a high-energy, relentlessly optimistic Account Executive with proven experience in SaaS and the real estate/proptech sector. You are a confident “hustler” who sees the glass as half full and thrives in a high-activity sales environment.

This is a pure new business role where you will own a defined territory and named-account set in the DACH region. You will control the pipeline you create and oversee the commercial outcome of every deal from the first conversation to the final signature. Singu supports complex property and facilities operations across more than 250 million square metres, with established customers spanning commercial real estate, logistics, retail, facility management, and the public sector. You will enter deals with credible enterprise references, a proven product, and senior executive support.

The deals are consequential rather than transactional: multi-stakeholder, multi-site, and typically take six to nine months to close. Initial deal values range from £25k to £100k and have clear multi-country expansion potential. Winning requires a strong business case, quantified value discovery, and the ability to align stakeholders across operations, real estate, procurement, IT, and finance.

Core Capabilities & What You Will Own

Strategic Navigator & Deal Execution

  • Deeply understand account politics and decision-making structures to “connect the dots” within complex opportunities.

  • Ensure opportunities are qualified to a MEDDICC standard, featuring a quantified business case and direct access to the economic buyer.

  • Ensure every material deal is multi-threaded so that it survives any change of internal sponsor.

  • Lead commercial negotiations that build value and protect price, rather than defaulting to discounts.

  • Apply rigorous qualification to make early decisions on opportunities that lack a credible business case, buying process, or route to decision.

Relationship Builder & “Land and Expand”

  • Cultivate strong connections and effectively influence key stakeholders across your target audience.

  • Scope first wins so they can grow, ensuring sites, countries, and use cases are sequenced from the start.

  • Execute a clean handover to Customer Success with a fully documented expansion path.

Market Educator & Alliance Builder

  • Proactively educate market participants and win strategic partners to build valuable alliances.

Driven Execution, Pipeline & Coverage

  • Maintain a high volume of sales activity with resilience, confidence, and a proactive mindset.

  • Take personal responsibility for territory coverage, hitting a new business quota mapped out by a strategic territory plan.

  • Build pipeline through business development, marketing, partner channels, and self-generated activity.

jobs.title: Lead Designer
Afstuderen: Integratie van machine data voor resourceplanning
jobs.description:
WAT GA JE DOEN?

Bij onze internationale klanten wordt voor de dagelijkse productie gebruikgemaakt van verschillende LogicSteel software applicaties. LogicSteel MRP ondersteunt hierbij operationele processen, zoals het plannen van productie, het beheren van projecten, inkooporders en het aansturen van medewerkers. Daarnaast zijn er systemen zoals Insights die machine- en prestatiegegevens inzichtelijk maken. Doordat informatie verdeeld is over meerdere applicaties, ontbreekt vaak één centraal overzicht voor resourceplanning en capaciteitsbeslissingen.

Tijdens deze afstudeeropdracht onderzoek je hoe relevante gegevens uit deze systemen beter gecombineerd en gepresenteerd kunnen worden, zodat gebruikers sneller de juiste inzichten hebben voor het plannen van mensen, machines en productiecapaciteit.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het analyseren van het huidige resourceallocatieproces en de rol van machine- en productiegegevens hierin;

  • Het voeren van interviews met gebruikers om hun doelen, behoeften en knelpunten in kaart te brengen;

  • Het onderzoeken welke data uit Insights en MRP relevant is voor besluitvorming;

  • Het analyseren van gebruikersstromen, beschikbare data en bestaande schermen;

  • Het ontwikkelen van wireframes, gebruikersflows en ontwerpconcepten;

  • Het valideren en verbeteren van ontwerpen door middel van feedbacksessies met gebruikers en stakeholders;

  • Het vertalen van gebruikersbehoeften naar functionele requirements;

  • Het opstellen van een advies voor de integratie en presentatie van machinegegevens over verschillende platformen.

Het eindresultaat is een onderbouwd ontwerp- en implementatievoorstel waarmee gebruikers sneller en beter onderbouwde beslissingen kunnen nemen op het gebied van resourceplanning en machinebezetting.


WIJ VRAGEN

  • HBO- of WO-opleiding in de richting van UI/UX Design, Human Computer Interaction, Interaction Technology of vergelijkbaar.

WIJ BIEDEN

  • Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt;

  • Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software;

  • Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen;

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Over Voortman

Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. Deze 3 krachtige bouwstenen maken ons Twentse, internationale familiebedrijf uniek.

You know how to walk into an enterprise, spot the pain points in its ERP processes, and see what good could look like. The world's largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas, not the speed of the systems they run on. Today they don't, and you've seen why firsthand.

Every new product line, pricing change or process redesign runs into SAP estates layered with decades of custom code, user exits and enhancements no single person fully understands. Requirements take months to ship. S/4HANA migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain, and the 2027 ECC deadline is forcing every large enterprise to face it.

We're building the AI operating system that absorbs this complexity and gives enterprises back their speed. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems. We've closed game-changing SI partnerships, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is outpacing what we can service.

We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work out of London and NYC. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company and how the world's largest companies operate. We sponsor visas and are convinced diverse teams build better products, so we especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.

What you'll own

You will make sure Conduct lands and sticks inside our most strategic SAP customers. You join accounts early, shape how Conduct fits into their transformation programmes, and fully take over post-sale. You'll have a direct line from what you see in the field to what ships in the product.

  • Be the SAP brain in the room. Translate between CIOs, process owners, Basis teams and our engineers. Scope use cases across finance, supply chain, procurement and sales that land real value fast.

  • Design the transformation. Get under the skin of complex, heavily customised ECC and S/4HANA landscapes. Conceptualise where Conduct can have the biggest impact, then lead the deployment that gets the customer there.

  • Turn pilots into partnerships. Onboard hundreds of end users, prove ROI, spot expansion signals and hold the early commercial conversations that grow an account.

  • Shape the product. You'll have a direct line into product and engineering. Your view of how SAP actually runs in the real world will shape our roadmap.

  • Build the engine. Our GTM team is small and lean. You'll build the onboarding flows, tooling and reusable playbooks that let customer capacity compound without headcount growing linearly.

  • Work with our SI partners. You speak their language. Help partners deploy Conduct inside their own programmes.

No two days look the same. You'll fly out to customers when it counts and spend the rest of the time building alongside the team.

We're looking for people obsessed with delivering for customers. You'll fit right in if former colleagues would, without hesitating, call you one of the sharpest people they've worked with.

  • 3+ years in SAP or ERP consulting, at a Big Four firm, a global SI or a specialist SAP partner. You've been on live implementations, rollouts or S/4HANA transformations, not just advisory.

  • Real depth in at least one area of SAP. Functional (FI/CO, SD, MM, PP, EWM), technical (ABAP, integration, BTP) or solution architecture. You understand how processes and custom code fit together across the landscape.

You'll own the Lending API in Germany, which banks, fintechs, brokers, and comparison sites build on to offer iwoca's finance to their customers. You'll decide how it evolves and help build the features that make partners choose iwoca.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £5 billion in funding. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Introducer Tech builds the systems that partners in Germany use to refer businesses to iwoca. The aim is to get new partners integrated quickly and to make applying simple for their customers. The team also looks after how partners earn commission.

Its work covers three main areas:

  • The Lending API. Developing the versioned API and the webhooks that keep partners up to date on their customers.

  • The Introducer Portal. Building the web app that German brokers log in to, to submit applications and upload documents.

  • The sign-up journey. Improving how businesses apply and how well they convert, after a partner referral.

The team is growing to have two product managers, who each focus on either the broker or the partner flow, and three engineers across the backend and frontend, including this hire.

The team currently works in sprints, with three stand-ups a week and planning every two weeks. However, there is room to adapt how it works as it grows.

The role

You'll be the senior engineer behind iwoca's broker and partner channels in Germany, from the tools partners integrate with to the internal systems that broker account managers use.

Ownership and autonomy

  • Own the Lending API in Germany end to end, deciding what to build, when to release a new version, when to retire an old one, and what iwoca can promise partners.

Impact

  • Ship the features that make partners choose iwoca, starting with pre-qualification, which shows a customer what they could borrow before they apply.

  • Make integration quick and simple, so a partner can go live with few questions and little hand-holding.

  • Automate parts of the broker funnel and the internal CRM that broker account managers use, cutting friction and the lag between a decision and the action that follows, and building agents wherever they help.

Growth trajectory

  • Set the team's technical direction and shape the product and technical roadmap alongside the product manager.

  • Align designs with the UK engineers who share the API, so German requirements shape the design from the start.

  • As well as being hands on, you’ll develop your mentoring and coaching skills. You’ll help lead the team as the most senior engineer.

You'll work with the commercial colleagues who bring in new partners, and join the team's weekly support rotation.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Backend engineering. You've designed and built production backend systems in Python – ideally with Django, though FastAPI or Flask count too. You've used PostgreSQL or another relational database in production, and kept it fast and maintainable.

  • API design. You've built and evolved APIs that other teams or companies depend on, and made the decisions on structure, versioning, and change.

  • Ownership. You've taken work from a commercial problem through to production – scoping the solution, making the trade-offs, and iterating based on how people use it.

  • Mentoring. You've helped other engineers grow through code reviews and design sessions.

  • AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Full-stack. You've contributed to frontend codebases, particularly in React or TypeScript.

  • CI/CD. You've set up or maintained the pipelines that test and release a production service.

  • Measurement. You've used data, metrics, or A/B tests to check whether a change had the effect you intended.

The salary

We expect to pay from £80,000 to £100,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

About GRI

Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) is the independent nonprofit organization that is the architect of the common global language to assess and report on environmental, social, and economic impacts. GRI provides standards, tools, and training that empower organizations of all sizes to create sustainable, long-term value and unlock positive change in the world.

For over 25 years, GRI has led a global multi-stakeholder process to develop and refine rigorous yet practical approaches to sustainability reporting, which meet the needs of all stakeholders. The  GRI Standards, the world’s most widely used sustainability reporting standards, provide the building blocks for transparent reporting on impacts.  Working at GRI, you will be part of unlocking positive change in the world.  

 

About the role

The Senior Manager Finance owns budgeting and financial analysis to support the CFO and budget holders in business decision-making. The role also oversees day-to-day finance operations, financial controls and external reporting, and provides line management and guidance to a finance colleague.
