jobs.description:
Revenue Operations Manager - HubSpot (w/m/d)

Deine Rolle

Du entwickelst das HubSpot-Setup von LIQID weiter: Du baust Workflows, Automationen und Integrationen, die Sales und Relationship Management im Tagesgeschäft unterstützen und machst aus den Daten im System ein Reporting, auf das sich Team und Führung verlassen können.

Den laufenden Betrieb der Plattform hältst du dabei stabil: Berechtigungen, Lizenzen, Datenqualität, Dokumentation. Der Schwerpunkt deiner Arbeit liegt jedoch auf dem Bauen, nicht auf dem Verwalten.

System und Team

HubSpot Sales Hub und Service Hub sind in diesem Jahr frisch implementiert. Du triffst also kein fertiges System an, das verwaltet werden will, sondern eine Plattform im Aufbau. Entsprechend groß sind der Gestaltungsspielraum und die Verantwortung für saubere Grundlagen.

Du berichtest an den Lead Revenue Operations und arbeitest eng mit Sales und Relationship Management zusammen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Baue Workflows, Sequences, Pipelines und Lead Routing in HubSpot Marketing Hub, Sales Hub und Service Hub: von der Verteilung eingehender Leads über Meeting-Links bis zu automatischen Aufgaben in Sales und Relationship Management.

  • Übersetze Anforderungen aus Sales und Relationship Management in konkrete HubSpot-Logik und löse wiederkehrende Handarbeit durch Automationen ab.

  • Kollaboriere mit unserem Data Team bezüglich Datenaustausch und -aufbereitung zwischen den relevanten Kernsystemen.

  • Verbinde HubSpot mit dem übrigen TechStack, also Aircall, Google Workspace, Notion und Slack, über native Connectoren, APIs, Webhooks oder Automatisierungstools. Entwickle das Toolstack sinnvoll weiter.

  • Entwickle unseren Sales Prozess kontinuierlich inhaltlich weiter und optimiere die technische Implementierung und Erfolgsmessung.

  • Baue Reports und Dashboards, die Pipeline, Aktivitäten und Ergebnisse für Sales, Relationship Management und Führung nachvollziehbar machen.

  • Verwalte Nutzer, Teams und Berechtigungen im laufenden Betrieb und halte die Konfiguration dokumentiert, statt sie im Kopf zu behalten.

  • Schule Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Umgang mit HubSpot und beantworte als erste Anlaufstelle Fragen zum System.

Das bringst du mit

  • Sicherer Umgang mit HubSpot Marketing Hub, Sales Hub und Service Hub, insbesondere als Admin und mit Workflows, Properties, Pipelines und Reporting.

  • Erfahrung im Bau von Integrationen über APIs, Webhooks oder Automatisierungstools wie Zapier oder Make.

  • Verständnis für CRM-Datenmodelle und die Fähigkeit, Datenqualität über Standards und Automationen zu sichern statt über Nachpflege.

  • Erfahrung mit der Prozessgestaltung erfolgreicher Vertriebsprozesse sowie deren Umsetzung in CRM-Systemen.

  • Erfahrung darin, fachliche Anforderungen aufzunehmen, in Systemlogik zu übersetzen und Entscheidungen so zu dokumentieren, dass andere daran weiterarbeiten können.

  • Fähigkeit, technische Zusammenhänge verständlich zu erklären und Kolleginnen und Kollegen ohne Systemhintergrund zu schulen.

  • Deutsch auf verhandlungssicherem Niveau (B2) für die Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen und Englisch auf gutem Arbeitsniveau.

Von Vorteil

  • HubSpot-Zertifizierungen

  • Erfahrung mit gängigen Automatisierungslösungen wie n8n, zapier oder make.com

  • Erfahrung in einem regulierten Umfeld, etwa Finanzdienstleistungen

  • Erfahrung mit einer CRM-Migration oder einem CRM-Rollout

  • Grundkenntnisse in JavaScript oder Python für Custom-Code-Actions

Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen? Bewirb dich trotzdem bei uns! Wir sind gespannt auf deine Bewerbung!

Das bieten wir dir

  • Vielfalt: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich ab Tag 1 zum integralen Bestandteil unseres bunten Teams aus internationalen Talenten.

  • Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht kompliziert. In flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und Mobile-Working-Regelungen findest du die richtige Balance. 28 Tage Urlaub und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31.12. verschaffen dir zudem entspannte Auszeiten.

  • Wertschätzung: Du gestaltest mit uns die Zukunft des digitalen Wealth Managements in einem innovativen, mehrfach ausgezeichneten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs, mit hoher Marktrelevanz und viel Raum für deine Ideen.

  • Smart Money: Als LIQIDian erhältst du attraktive Konditionen für unsere Anlagestrategien, einen monatlichen Lunch-Zuschuss und exklusive Discounts bei verschiedenen Anbietern.

  • Wohlbefinden: Regionale Bio-Produkte halten Dich vor Ort im Office fit – und unsere Gesundheitsinitiativen oder unser Health Assistance Programm auch weit darüber hinaus.

     

Über uns

Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. jobs.title: Senior High Voltage Systems Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description:
Your Mission:

VÆRIDION is a pioneering electric aircraft Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) dedicated to revolutionizing regional air mobility and sustainable aviation. We are committed to designing and producing cutting-edge electric conventional take-off and landing (eCTOL) aircraft that provide safe, efficient, and environmentally friendly transportation solutions.

As a Senior High Voltage Systems Engineer, you will significantly contribute to the design, development, and certification of the aircraft's high voltage systems. You will work as part of a multi-functional team, reporting to the HV Systems Team Lead, and covering HV system development and electrical integration, including battery systems, power electronics, HV EWIS, distribution equipment and associated sub-systems. Your daily tasks will include a variety of technical activities for the HV Electrical Systems team.

Every day will bring new challenges, and you will be given a healthy amount of responsibility and autonomy, always supported by the team.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Define performance, functional, installation and other applicable system requirements, allocate them to components, and plan and support their validation and verification (V&V) in line with standards such as ARP4754.

  • Define HV system functions, architecture, sizing and specifications, and integrate the aircraft HV distribution system to meet safety and performance requirements.

  • Develop interface control documents (ICDs) covering physical and functional interfaces with the aircraft structure and related systems.

  • Lead technical tasks for Microliner development and certification, and create system documentation from requirements definition to demonstration of compliance.

  • Define aircraft-level HV electrical bonding and grounding requirements and their implementation.

  • Coordinate HV system safety analyses and systems engineering activities, address environmental conditions including HIRF and EMI, and define lightning protection requirements for the HV propulsion electrical network based on the defined aircraft lightning zones.

  • Define and specify the aircraft charging interface, and break down its requirements to component level.

  • Specify power quality and electrical insulation requirements and draft the aircraft electrical load analysis, including tasks such as defining and maintaining a Y-capacitance budget for the propulsion electrical network and allocating limits to components.

  • Support integration of the HV system digital mock-up (DMU) into the aircraft 3D model.

  • Identify, assess and manage suppliers, and own work packages for the development, installation and integration of HV components, including fuses, switches, harnesses and grounding systems.

  • Perform or support analyses and simulations to improve HV propulsion battery performance, reliability and integration into the propulsion system.

  • Participate in supplier technical and program reviews (TRM and PRM) and key milestones, including PDR, CDR, First Flight and Type Certification.

  • Define and plan HV equipment qualification campaigns with the Technology Department, suppliers and other stakeholders.

  • Prepare, commission, troubleshoot and execute HV hardware and software tests, from component benches to full-scale prototypes and aircraft ground and flight tests.

  • Follow engineering processes and standards, and contribute to design reviews supporting development and certification goals.

 

Your Profile:

  • Master’s degree or higher in electrical engineering or a related field.

  • Proven experience of at least 5 years in electrical systems design and integration within an aerospace OEM or similar industry (preferably automotive).

  • Experience with electric aircraft is a plus, including power electronics, energy storage and electric propulsion systems.

  • Working knowledge of systems engineering and safety analyses per aerospace standards such as ARP4754 and ARP4761 or automotive standard such as ISO26262. Proficiency on airborne hardware and software qualification per ED-12/ED-80 (DO-178/DO-254), and practical experience with aircraft certification is a plus.

  • Practical experience with aircraft certification process (preferably EASA/FAA Part 23 or 25).

  • Experience working in an EASA Part 21J Design Organization, or international equivalent is preferred.

  • Assertive and clear communication skills, results-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Ability to interact efficiently with customers, authorities, suppliers, and internal organizational units.

  • Proven ability to prioritize, manage, and execute multiple simultaneous tasks.

  • Skilled in navigating early design uncertainties and driving progress through proactive proposals and collaborative idea sharing.

  • Positive and optimistic attitude, with a collaborative approach in a multicultural team, adhering to company rules and values.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; proficiency in another European language is a plus.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of the aviation industry.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

From core gameplay tuning and mechanic development through to polished, data-informed level iterations, you’ll take ownership of the player experience and continually raise the quality bar.

You’ll work closely with game designers, artists, developers and analysts to ensure the match-3 is satisfying, intuitive and rewarding, evolving its mechanics, pacing and feel so that the game’s creative vision and long-term engagement goals come through. You’ll use player feedback, analytics and playtesting to refine gameplay, experiment with new ideas and shape the ongoing evolution of the game’s core puzzle experience.

As a senior member of the team, you’ll also help shape our level production strategy, driving quality with both internal development and external partners while contributing to the long-term direction of the game.

  • Own the design of blockers, boosters and rewards and shape satisfying level progression

  • Partner with Art to ensure levels are visually readable, aesthetically cohesive and support the game’s creative vision.

  • Plan and own Match 3 content production, ensuring a consistent pipeline of high-quality content that supports development milestones and LiveOps.

    • Lead external level design contractors and outsourcing partners by providing clear briefs, regular feedback and quality reviews, ensuring all delivered content meets Treefrog’s standards.

  • Mentor other designers through feedback, knowledge sharing and collaborative problem solving.

What You Have

  • Experience shipping successful free-to-play match-3 or puzzle games.

  • Experience designing LiveOps events, seasonal content or limited-time game modes.

  • Strong understanding of player progression, retention, engagement and monetisation in puzzle.

  • Experience improving level editors, pipelines or content creation workflows.

  • Experience leading small feature teams or mentoring designers.

  • Have a deep understanding of the competition and genre trends.

  • Passion for cosy games and creating emotionally engaging player experiences.

Working closely with the Head of the CEO Office, you will combine structured problem-solving with hands-on execution. You will translate priorities into coordinated action, strengthen how teams operate and drive initiatives through to impact.

This is neither a traditional PMO nor a presentation-led strategy role, and it is not an executive-level position. Success requires sound judgement, analytical rigour, clear communication, operational follow-through and the ability to influence effectively without formal authority.

How You'll Make an Impact (Role overview)

  • Support the CEO and Head of the CEO Office on critical cross-functional initiatives by helping coordinate day-to-day delivery, stakeholder collaboration and progress towards measurable outcomes.

  • Help investigate complex, ambiguous problems by clarifying the problem, developing practical solutions and supporting the implementation of durable processes or systems.

  • Support departments in scaling by contributing to organisation design, objectives and KPI setting, and the development of robust operating processes.

  • Assist leadership in navigating ambiguity by surfacing insights, decisions and risks, coordinating follow-through and supporting alignment across teams, particularly where there is no natural owner.

  • Projects may include organisational model design, international expansion strategy, scaling new business lines, strategic planning and goal setting, go-to-market execution, regulatory, data and financial infrastructure initiatives, and supporting board and shareholder reporting.

  • Ownership and impact: Personally own cross-functional work and deliver measurable outcomes.

  • Influence and collaboration: Build trust, navigate trade-offs and make progress across functions without formal authority, with a low-ego and collaborative approach.

  • Learning agility and entrepreneurial mindset: Learn quickly, respond well to feedback, adapt to changing priorities and show evidence of creating, launching or materially improving something from scratch. Founding or entrepreneurial experience is valued but not required.

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

🚀 About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with a front-end focus who has experience working with commercial. You’ll turn a marketing campaign, a pricing test or a new product launch into a fast, reliable experience, then measure whether it worked.

Your main focus will be zoe.com and our acquisition and conversion journeys, including landing pages, checkout, sign-up and product launches across our app subscriptions and physical products. You’ll spend most of your time in TypeScript, React and Next.js, and you’ll work in our backend services (Kotlin or Python) whenever a feature needs it.

This is a senior individual contributor role. We’re looking for someone who works autonomously, makes sound decisions independently and takes full ownership of their work.

💻 Our Stack

  • Frontend: TypeScript, React, Next.js, React, GraphQL

  • Backend: Kotlin / Spring Boot, Python / FastAPI and Django

  • Tools: DatoCMS / headless CMS, Optimizely / AB testing tools, Grafana, Sentry, Firebase Auth

  • CI/CD: ArgoCD, GitHub Actions

  • Data: web data layer, dbt, BigQuery

  • Infrastructure: GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, Vercel

👥 About the Team

You’ll join ZOE’s Growth team, which drives how people discover, learn and become a member. Growth sits where engineering meets the commercial side of the business. We work closely with marketing, CRM, product, design and analytics to turn ideas into experiments, and experiments into results.

Our wider Engineering team is a distributed across the UK and EU, with skills spanning web, mobile and backend engineering, machine learning, data science and analytics. We’re proud of the diversity in our team: 39% female and 61% male, with colleagues from many backgrounds, cultures and lived experiences. We believe this makes us stronger, more creative and better able to serve our global community.

Above all, we value curiosity, openness and empowerment. We encourage everyone to share ideas, keep learning and shape how we work.

🎯 What you’ll be doing

  • Owning growth initiatives end to end: from shaping the idea with commercial partners, through technical delivery, to measuring the result.

  • Partnering with commercial teams: working day to day with marketing, CRM and product to deliver campaigns, launches and acquisition journeys, often to tight, business-critical deadlines.

  • Running experiments: designing, launching and analysing A/B tests with our analysts, and using the results to decide what to build next.

  • Building a fast, high-converting zoe.com: owning web performance, accessibility and conversion across key journeys such as landing pages, sign-up and checkout.

  • Adapting to changing priorities: making pragmatic trade-offs when plans change, and helping the team decide what to build, what to defer and what to drop.

  • Working across the stack: shaping APIs and making backend changes where growth features need them, in Kotlin or Python.

  • Contributing to the design system: helping grow our shared component library so the team can ship consistent experiences quickly.

  • Shipping continuously: releasing to production daily, often more than once, with the testing and monitoring in place to do so safely.

🧠 We think you’d be great if you…

  • Have 5+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong focus on front-end.

  • Have strong experience with TypeScript, React and Next.js, and know how to build fast, accessible and well-tested web experiences.

  • Have worked closely with commercial functions such as marketing, growth, sales or CRM, and enjoy turning business goals into product outcomes.

  • Have hands-on experience with experimentation and analytics, such as A/B testing, conversion optimisation or funnel analysis.

  • Work autonomously: you take ownership of ambiguous problems, make decisions with limited guidance and keep stakeholders informed.

  • Have working knowledge of a backend language (such as Python, Kotlin or Java) and are comfortable making backend changes.

As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

The opportunity

This is a new-logo role. You'll win large warehousing, logistics and industrial property owners, operators and FM organisations across the UK that don't work with us yet. You'll run the full sales cycle, from the first cold conversation to signature. Once an account goes live, Customer Success takes it from there.

You'll work a defined UK territory of named target accounts. You'll have reference customers that carry real weight in the supply chain sector, and direct access to the CRO and CEO, who will join your deals when it matters.

What you'll do

Build your own pipeline

  • Build and work a named list of target accounts across UK warehousing, logistics and industrial real estate, with a clear view of why each one should change and what it would take.

  • Generate most of your own pipeline. Business development and marketing will help, but you're the hunter.

  • Reach C-suite and operational leaders through outbound, industry networks, events, partners and existing customer relationships.

Win complex enterprise deals

  • Run the full cycle: discovery, business case, evaluation, negotiation and signature.

  • Replace incumbent CAFM/IWMS platforms, in-house systems and spreadsheet-based processes.

  • Navigate buying groups, procurement, IT security and legal without losing momentum.

  • Qualify rigorously with MEDDICC and use mutual action plans on every live deal.

  • Shape the commercial structure of each deal: pricing, multi-year terms, phased rollouts and land-and-expand entry points.

Lead with the business case

  • Earn access to CFOs, COOs, CIOs, Heads of Real Estate and operations leaders.

  • Sell on operating cost, compliance exposure, portfolio performance and risk, not on a feature demo.

  • Bring in Presales, Product and executive sponsors on the deals that justify it.

Forecast with discipline

  • Keep a forecast you can defend line by line and a CRM that reflects reality.

  • Disqualify early and visibly. Time spent on a real deal is worth more than a pipeline that only looks full.

  • Share competitive and market insight with product, marketing and pricing.

  • 5+ years in B2B software sales, at an established, credible software business.
